title: Director of Global HR Business Partnering
description: <p><strong>Realize your potential by joining the leading performance-driven advertising company! </strong></p> <p>Operating from our London office, the Global Director of HR Business Partnering will lead and manage the global HRBP function through the Regional Directors of HR, while owning and executing the HR roadmap for the global Growth Sales business group, with the same partnering responsibilities as other HRBPs.<br><br>You will help leaders make sound people and organisation decisions and enable Taboolars to do their best work. Bring judgement, business knowledge, relationships and delivery to work that cannot be automated, handled by managers alone or delivered at scale by shared services. Offer an independent commercial view, ensure fair and consistent treatment, and be approachable to employees. Credibility comes from balancing these responsibilities.</p> <p><strong>To thrive in this role, you'll need:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven experience leading global teams (including managing managers) across locations, a clear standard for great HR partnering and the ability to bring all HRBPs to that standard.</li> <li>Strong global ER experience and judgement, including when to seek advice or hand over.</li> <li>Strong business understanding; the ability to identify underlying issues and patterns, beyond what you are told, and make independent, well-reasoned recommendations.</li> <li>Sound operating-model judgement and the ability to distinguish performance from potential in making fair decisions.</li> <li>To be someone who views AI and automation as the ultimate leverage for HR. You don’t need to be a data scientist, but you should be someone who reads about LLMs, experiments with productivity tools, and dreams of an HR department where technology handles the routine so people can handle the exceptional </li> <li>Confidence to influence, challenge constructively, reset expectations with senior leaders and support the team.</li> <li>Emotional and cultural intelligence, care for people, and judgement that balances commercial, legal, people and organisational considerations.</li> <li>Ability to embed change and follow through after decisions.</li> <li>Experience of effective collaboration with operations and analytics to deliver at scale, and across time zones and legal systems: acknowledge knowledge gaps and work through regional colleagues.</li> <li>Clear judgement on when to step in and when work belongs elsewhere.</li> <li>Experience of implementing AI and automation for routine work, rethinking how work is done as well as digitising it.</li> <li>A collaborative approach that strengthens the whole People Ops team.</li> </ul> <p><strong>How you’ll make an impact:</strong></p> <p>As a Director of Global HR Business Partnering you’ll bring value by:<br><br>Leading the Global HRBP Department:</p> <ul> <li>Set priorities, ways of working and the standard for good partnering; build a high-performing team people want to join. Own capability, development and careers across the team.</li> <li>Coach the team on ER cases, deferring to the Employee Relations Centres of Expertise (CoEs) for more complex matters.</li> <li>Allocate HRBP capacity across global and regional responsibilities according to region and business-group size and complexity.</li> <li>Ensure HRBP role clarity by setting up and upholding boundaries between HR BPs, managers, the Shared Service Centre (SSC), Internal Operations and CoEs.</li> <li>Own the HR BP contribution to annual people processes by ensuring prepared HR BPs, consistent communication and effective support for leaders.</li> <li>Own HR BP headcount and budget.</li> <li>Be accountable for improving productivity, retaining critical talent, developing capable managers, embedding change and improving people and organisation decisions.</li> </ul> <p>Managing your own HRBP Responsiblitlies:</p> <p>VP partnership and global remit:</p> <ul> <li>Sit on your VP’s leadership team, agree functional people priorities and remain their main HR contact when involving regional colleagues or specialists. Understand their strategy, commercial pressures, obstacles and organisation; anticipate people issues and offer your own view.</li> <li>Take a global view of the function’s strategy, structure, talent, annual cycles and patterns. Lead performance, talent review and calibration, and compensation cycles from start to finish: manage and allocate budgets, maintain regional consistency, run calibration, handle exceptions and agree dates within global timelines. Regional HR BPs help local managers prepare proposals and provide market context; you lead the process and support the VP’s final decisions.</li> </ul> <p>Talent and organisation advice:</p> <ul> <li>Advise on talent, performance, workforce and structure, including succession, critical-talent retention, promotions, calibration, team design and accountability. Interpret data from People Analytics & Data Insights and recommend action linked to business needs.</li> </ul> <p>Manager capability and change:</p> <ul> <li> Help managers interpret people data rather than producing it, and use your judgment to provide insights and inform good decision making <br>Coach managers through matters they can handle themselves, rather than taking over, building their confidence and capability.<br>Put decisions into practice: explain the context, support leaders and look after people through change.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Why Taboola?</strong></p> <p>If you ask Taboolars what they love about working here, they’ll tell you that they’ve been empowered to realize their full potential while growing and learning from and with smart and talented people. They’ll also share more about:</p> <ul> <li>Adam Singolda, Taboola Founder and CEO says; “You can copy anything from another business but you can’t copy a company’s culture.</li> <li><strong>Well-being:</strong> With an office culture that’s international, social and supportive, Taboola offers very generous benefits including 20 days holiday, excellent health insurance, some flexible working, and stock options to name just a few.</li> <li><strong>Flexibility: </strong>We offer a hybrid work schedule with 3 days in-office with an option to come in more often if desired.</li> <li><strong>Work with some of the biggest names: </strong>We work with some of the biggest names in the business. Our publisher partners include Yahoo, Conde Nast, Fox Sports, NBCU, ESPN, CBS, and E! Online. Our advertiser clients include Wells Fargo, Honda, Pinterest and Expedia </li> </ul> <p><strong>Ready to realize your potential?</strong></p> <p>Taboola is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity in all forms. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and believe such an environment is critical for success. Employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.</p> <p>Learn more about #TaboolaLife on<a href="https://www.linkedin.com/search/results/all/?fetchDeterministicClustersOnly=true&heroEntityKey=urn%3Ali%3Aorganization%3A128707&keywords=taboola&origin=RICH_QUERY_SUGGESTION&position=2&searchId=dcc8bfbb-b05c-458e-a7f1-726d30e7dd80&sid=9(y&spellCorrectionEnabled=false"> LinkedIn</a>,<a href="https://www.facebook.com/taboola/"> Facebook</a>,<a href="https://www.instagram.com/taboola.israel/?hl=en"> Instagram</a>,<a href="https://docs.google.com/document/d/1BctKkw2Vj_EOjvy24kjRKq_ZxZzmZxweIqNLQgsLtcs/edit?tab=t.0"> X</a>,<a href="https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC6W0hdStO0jRVYhg4ABzjRw"> YouTube</a>, & the<a href="https://blog.taboola.com/category/taboola-life/?_gl=1*1c2v1ec*_ga*MTI4NTM3OTcyNy4xNjkxNTA0MjA0*_ga_ERHENNM7DM*MTcxMDM1MDIwMi4yMjMuMS4xNzEwMzUwMjI5LjMzLjAuMA.."> Taboola Life Blog</a>.</p> <p><strong>About Taboola</strong></p> <p>Taboola empowers businesses to grow through performance advertising technology that goes beyond search and social and delivers measurable outcomes at scale.</p> <p>Taboola works with thousands of businesses who advertise directly on Realize, Taboola’s powerful ad platform, reaching approximately 600M daily active users across some of the best publishers in the world. Publishers like NBC News, Yahoo, and OEMs such as Samsung, Xiaomi and others use Taboola’s technology to grow audience and revenue, enabling Realize to offer unique data, specialized algorithms, and unmatched scale.</p> <p><strong>Sounds good, how do I apply?</strong><strong><br></strong><strong><br></strong>It’s easy, submit your CV by clicking the “Apply” button below. </p> <p>#LI-DS1</p> <p>#LI-Hybrid</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer (Database Focus)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>About us</strong></h3> <p>GoCardless, a Mollie company, is a global leader in bank payments. Over 100,000 businesses, from start-ups to household names, use GoCardless to collect, manage and send bank payments through Direct Debit, real-time payments and open banking. With US$130bn+ processed annually across 30+ countries, we handle recurring and one-off payments without the chasing, stress, or expensive fees. Our end-to-end payment platform also features AI-powered solutions to improve payment success and reduce fraud, alongside connections to over 350 platforms businesses use everyday.<br><br>We are headquartered in the UK, with teams and operations spanning North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific.  For more information, please visit<span><a href="http://www.gocardless.com" target="_blank"> www.gocardless.com</a></span> and follow us on LinkedIn<span><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/gocardless" target="_blank"> ----- is the leading payments and financial services partner for business, rooted in Europe, with global reach.</p></div><h3><strong>Platform Engineering at GoCardless</strong></h3> <p>The Platform Engineering team is a unified, globally distributed team, currently located in London, Riga and Lisbon. We work with all other engineering teams to empower them to build, release, run and scale their products, with a strong focus on both strategic project delivery and operational excellence.</p> <p><strong>Our work is a balance of:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Project delivery:</strong> building new platform components, from initial design to deployment.</li> <li><strong>Operational support:</strong> keeping our systems healthy and stable through on-call rotations and incident management.</li> <li><strong>Business as usual:</strong> continuous maintenance, improvements, and support for audits and compliance.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>The role</strong></h3> <p>We’re looking for a Senior SRE with deep PostgreSQL expertise to own the reliability, performance and scalability of our database estate. Our databases sit at the heart of a payments platform, so slowdowns and outages directly affect our customers.</p> <p>You’ll work across our self-managed Stolon clusters and our GCP Cloud SQL fleet. Joining Mollie gives us the opportunity to consolidate, modularise and rethink how we run production databases, and you’ll help us do that while keeping everything reliable.</p> <p><strong>What excites you  </strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Run our database fleet reliably.</strong> Keep our production databases healthy and stable through significant change, including moves between platforms.</li> <li><strong>Own performance and capacity.</strong> Right-size instances, tune connection limits and pooling (PgBouncer), memory and autovacuum settings, and fix slow queries, N+1s and unused indexes before customers feel them.</li> <li><strong>Own upgrades and change.</strong> Lead major-version database upgrades end to end with minimal downtime, and own safe schema migrations, data migrations and backfills.</li> <li><strong>Build in resilience.</strong> Reduce idle-in-transaction sessions, tighten statement timeouts, and design and test failover, replication and backup and recovery.</li> <li><strong>Make it observable.</strong> Build dashboards and alerts in Grafana, Prometheus and Datadog to track saturation, latency and connection health.</li> <li><strong>Partner with application teams.</strong> Help them use their databases well and improve their query patterns.</li> <li><strong>Respond and learn.</strong> Take part in on-call, mitigate live database incidents, and run root cause analyses to prevent repeats.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What excites us</strong></p> <h4><strong>Skills</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Typically 5+ years of production experience running PostgreSQL, including high availability, replication, and backup and recovery</li> <li>Deep knowledge of Postgres performance and tuning: internals (memory settings, autovacuum, locking) and connection pooling, including managing it in production and supporting it on call</li> <li>Experience running production databases in the cloud, whether on managed services or self-managed on cloud infrastructure</li> <li>Strong query analysis skills (EXPLAIN plans, indexing strategy)</li> <li>Experience running major-version upgrades safely with minimal downtime</li> <li>Experience managing infrastructure as code with Terraform or similar IaC tooling</li> <li>Experience with monitoring and alerting (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog or similar)</li> <li>Experience writing code/working in software engineering teams</li> <li>Experience with on-call and incident response</li> <li>Ability to influence application teams</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with<a href="https://github.com/gocardless/stolon"> Stolon</a>, or similar Postgres HA tooling</li> <li>Experience with managed cloud Postgres (GCP CloudSQL, AWS RDS etc.)</li> <li>Experience with Kubernetes, GKE and ArgoCD</li> <li>Experience migrating databases between platforms</li> <li>Experience with SLOs and error budgets</li> <li>Experience in payments or financial services</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Why it matters</strong></h4> <p>We hope you’re enthusiastic about the infrastructure space and the impact your work can have on others. In this role:</p> <ul> <li>You’ll work on a core system with direct, measurable impact on the reliability of the payments.</li> <li>You’ll solve hard performance and reliability problems in systems that matter.</li> <li>You’ll shape our database approach at a pivotal moment, as joining Mollie opens up choices about how we structure our estate.</li> <li>You’ll have real influence on technical design and decisions, and the chance to raise the bar for those around you.</li> <li>You’ll work closely with application teams and build easy-to-understand, maintainable tools and automation.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Tech stack and tools</strong></h3> <ul> <li>PostgreSQL, Stolon, Cloud SQL, PgBouncer</li> <li>Python, Ruby, Golang</li> <li>Terraform, Atlantis</li> <li>GCP</li> <li>Kubernetes, GKE</li> <li>GitHub, ArgoCD</li> <li>Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog</li> </ul> <p>We use a wide range of technologies and will never expect you to have experience with all of them.</p> <p>Base salary range: <strong>£62,000 - £108,000</strong></p> <p>Base salary ranges are based on role, job level, location, and market data. Please note that whilst we strive to offer competitive compensation, our approach is to pay between the minimum and the mid-point of the pay range until performance can be assessed in role. Offers will take into account level of experience, interview assessment, budgets and parity between you and fellow employees at GoCardless doing similar work.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>(some of) The good stuff</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Wellbeing </strong>- stay healthy with dedicated support and medical cover</li> <li><strong>Lunch</strong>- based on the location, you either get a meal voucher or a paid lunch when working from the office</li> <li><strong>Work away scheme</strong> - gives you the option to work away from your country of residence for up to 20 working days in any 12-month period</li> <li><strong>Adaptive Working</strong> - allows you to work flexibly, around your lifestyle</li> <li><strong>Parental leave</strong> - to suit everyone embarking on life's great adventure</li> <li><strong>Learning Budget</strong> - lead your own development with an annual learning budget</li> <li><strong>Time off</strong> - generous holiday allowance + volunteer days for ERG events + one day off if you need to move house</li> </ul> <h3><strong style="font-size: 14px;">Life at GoCardless  </strong></h3> <p>We're an organisation defined by our<a href="https://gocardless.com/g/values-operating-principles/" target="_blank"> <u>values</u></a>; We <strong><em>start with why</em></strong><em> </em>before we begin any project, to ensure it’s aligned with our mission. We <strong><em>make it happen</em></strong>, working with urgency and taking personal accountability for getting things done. We<strong><em> act with integrity</em></strong>, always. We <strong><em>care deeply</em></strong> about what we do and we know it's essential that we <strong><em>be humble </em></strong>whilst we do it. Our Values form part of the GoCardless DNA, and are used to not only help us nurture and develop our culture, but to deliver impactful work that will help us to achieve our vision. </p> <h4><strong>Diversity & Inclusion</strong></h4> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">As of April 2025, we had 806 employees (GeeCees) globally, with 524 based in the UK, 163 based in Latvia and 119 across our other offices.</p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">To ensure that we're representative of the world around us - and to be able to review relevant benchmarks - we ask GeeCees to voluntarily disclose diversity data. This year, the proportion of GeeCees providing data increased to 88% (up from 79% in 2024). With regards to diversity within GoCardless, we can see GeeCees identifying as:</p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">Asian, Black, Mixed or Other — <strong>25%</strong> </p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">Neurodiverse — <strong>9%</strong> </p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">LGBTQIA+ — <strong>9%</strong> </p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">Disabled — <strong>1%</strong> </p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">Average age — <strong>33</strong></p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">Female — <strong>45%</strong></p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">Male — <strong> 55% </strong></p> <p>We’re rooting for you during your application and GoCardless aims to provide reasonable adjustments to make

title: Forward Deployed Engineer - Defence
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>C3 AI (NYSE: AI), is the Enterprise AI application software company. C3 AI delivers a family of fully integrated products including the C3 Agentic AI Platform, an end-to-end platform for developing, deploying, and operating enterprise AI applications, C3 AI applications, a portfolio of industry-specific SaaS enterprise AI applications that enable the digital transformation of organizations globally, and C3 Generative AI, a suite of domain-specific generative AI offerings for the enterprise. Learn more at: <strong><a href="https://c3.ai/" target="_blank"><span style="text-decoration: underline;">C3 AI</span></a></strong></p></div><p>As a <strong>Forward Deployed Engineer</strong>, you will be engineering full-stack AI-driven web applications on the C3 AI Platform, working directly with customers to design, develop, and deploy production applications, demos, and proofs-of-technology. An ideal candidate possesses strategic and analytical aptitude, software development expertise, and excellent interpersonal skills. You will work with some of the largest and most demanding organisations on the planet to build the next generation of AI-powered enterprise applications. You will work directly with data scientists, software engineers, and subject matter experts to define new analytics capabilities that give our customers the information they need to make decisions under pressure and accelerate their digital transformation.</p> <p>This is a frontline role on some of the most consequential AI programmes in UK and European defence today. You will help design and deploy AI that keeps aircraft and platforms mission-ready through predictive maintenance, that sharpens decision-making through Digital Targeting, and that sustains operations through logistics in contested and degraded environments. These are live programmes with real operational stakes, delivered into demanding, secure settings across the UK MOD, NATO, and allied European partners.</p> <p><strong>This role supports defence programmes that require UK Security Clearance. Candidates must hold, or be able to obtain and maintain, SC / NATO clearance. Eligibility is set by the contracting authority and typically requires a minimum of five years’ continuous UK residence. </strong></p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop and deploy applications. Engineer full-stack, AI-based enterprise applications on the C3 AI Platform.</li> <li>Mentor junior team members. Share coding standards and design techniques with less experienced engineers.</li> <li>Conduct design and code reviews. Review customer software applications for quality, architecture, and best practices.</li> <li>Test and enhance customer applications. Troubleshoot, test, and improve customer software applications directly and on behalf of customers.</li> <li>Deliver technical enablement. Lead technical deep-dives, product demonstrations, and customer training sessions.</li> <li>Write documentation. Produce application specifications, technical documentation, and supporting artifacts.</li> <li>Identify and mitigate risk. Continuously surface technical risks and gaps; devise mitigation strategies in anticipation of customer needs.</li> <li>Drive product improvement. Work closely with product management and engineering to improve the overall quality of C3 AI software.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>MSc or Bachelor’s degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM), or a comparable area of study.</li> <li>5+ years of professional software development experience with object-oriented programming languages.</li> <li>Strong verbal and written communication skills; ability to work effectively on a cross-functional team.</li> <li>Analytical, problem-solving abilities, organizational skills and attention to detail.</li> <li>Ability to travel as needed.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>PhD in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM), or a comparable area of study.</li> <li>Experience deploying enterprise-scale applications.</li> <li>Proficient Software development expertise with JavaScript and Python.</li> <li>Proficient with Git or other version control software.</li> <li>Experience working with JavaScript frameworks such as React, Redux, Vue, Backbone, or Angular.</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>C3 AI provides excellent benefits, a competitive compensation package and generous equity plan.</strong></span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>C3 AI is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristics, including disabled and veteran status. </p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Data Scientist - Defence
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>C3 AI (NYSE: AI), is the Enterprise AI application software company. C3 AI delivers a family of fully integrated products including the C3 Agentic AI Platform, an end-to-end platform for developing, deploying, and operating enterprise AI applications, C3 AI applications, a portfolio of industry-specific SaaS enterprise AI applications that enable the digital transformation of organizations globally, and C3 Generative AI, a suite of domain-specific generative AI offerings for the enterprise. Learn more at: <strong><a href="https://c3.ai/" target="_blank"><span style="text-decoration: underline;">C3 AI</span></a></strong></p></div><p>As a member of the <strong>C3 AI Data Science team</strong>, you will work with some of the largest companies on the planet helping them build the next generation of AI-powered enterprise applications on the C3 AI Platform (<a href="https://c3.ai/customers/">c3.ai/customers/</a>). You will work directly with data scientists, software engineers, and subject matter experts in the definition of new analytics capabilities able to provide our customers with the information they need to make proper decisions and enable their digital transformation. You will help find the appropriate machine learning algorithms to answer those questions and implement those on the C3 AI Platform so they can run at scale.<br><br>Qualified candidates will have an in-depth knowledge of most common machine learning techniques and their application. You will also understand the limitations of these algorithms and how to tweak them or derive from them to achieve similar results at large-scale.</p> <p>This is a frontline role on some of the most consequential AI programmes in UK and European defence today. You will help design and deploy AI that keeps aircraft and platforms mission-ready through predictive maintenance, that sharpens decision-making through Digital Targeting, and that sustains operations through logistics in contested and degraded environments. These are live programmes with real operational stakes, delivered into demanding, secure settings across the UK MOD, NATO, and allied European partners. </p> <p><strong><span data-teams="true">Note: This is a client-facing position. Data Scientists are expected to work on-site with our customers four days per week.</span></strong></p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead the research, design, implementation, and deployment of machine learning algorithms, intelligent agents, and optimisation solutions for enterprise applications leveraging the C3 AI Suite.</li> <li>Assist and enable C3 AI's customers to build their own applications on the C3 AI Suite.</li> <li>Contribute to the design and implementation of new features of the C3 AI Suite.</li> <li>Analyse model performance across asset fleets, diagnose issues such as low risk scores or false positives, and recommend hyperparameter adjustments.</li> <li>Collaborating with data and subject matter experts from C3 AI and its customer teams to seek, understand, validate, interpret, and correctly use new data elements.</li> </ul> <p><strong>This role supports defence programmes that require UK Security Clearance. Candidates must hold, or be able to obtain and maintain, SC / NATO clearance. Are you excited by the challenge of making them act?</p> <p>Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.</p> <p>The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.</p> <p>You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.</p> <p>If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.</p> <h2><strong>Why United Media</strong></h2> <p>United Media (<a href="https://www.united-media.com/">https://www.united-media.com/</a>) focuses on building large-scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, finance, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.</p> <h2><strong>What we offer you</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Master the highest bar in the world.</strong> Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.</li> <li><strong>Unlimited growth potential. </strong>You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.</li> <li><strong>Skills that compound for life.</strong> Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.</li> <li><strong>Ownership from the very start.</strong> You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.</li> <li><strong>Travel opportunity.</strong> You will be joining our 10+ conferences.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you will do</strong></h2> <p>Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Build the audience.</strong> Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.</li> <li><strong>Own marketing channels that drive revenue. </strong>Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue</li> <li><strong>Write copy that persuades.</strong> Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.</li> <li><strong>Sprint, test, implement.</strong> Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.</li> <li><strong>Build systems, not one-offs.</strong> Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.</li> <li><strong>Do whatever it takes to win.</strong> Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What we expect from you</strong></h2> <ul> <li>1 to 3 years of experience</li> <li>Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results</li> <li>A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.</li> <li>Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency</li> <li>Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do</li> <li>Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do</li> <li>A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people</li> <li>Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Practical details</strong></h2> <p>Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Director, Fraud Risk
description: About Airwallex Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own. We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full. About the Role As Director, Fraud, you will lead Airwallex’s First Line of Defence (1LoD) Fraud function. You will own the design, execution, and continuous optimization of our global fraud strategy, policies, detection systems, and operational workflows across Airwallex’s financial infrastructure. In this role, you will lead a high-performing team responsible for stopping fraud in real time while keeping friction low for legitimate, high-growth global businesses. Airwallex processes billions in cross-border payments, multi-currency corporate cards, merchant acquiring, and embedded finance products. You and your team will directly defend our ecosystem against card fraud, account takeover (ATO), merchant bust-out, payment scams, and synthetic identities. You will partner directly with Engineering, Data Science, Product, Legal, and Compliance and interface closely with Second Line Risk to build and operate scalable, AI-native fraud detection models, effective triaging processes and operational guardrails. What You’ll Do Define & Execute 1LoD Global Fraud Strategy: Direct and build out the operational fraud strategy across all Airwallex products (Global Accounts, FX, Acquiring, Cards, and Embedded Finance / BaaS). Translate enterprise risk appetite set by the board and 2LoD Risk into actionable rules, detection logic, operational policies, and loss-prevention workflows. Lead & Scale the 1LoD Fraud Team: Build, lead, and mentor a world-class team of fraud strategists, analysts, and operations specialists responsible for rule writing, alert triage, incident response, and dispute operations. Optimize Risk vs. Conversion: Own and execute real-time fraud decisioning rules, loss-mitigation frameworks, and chargeback monitoring programs. Drive precision in risk controls to reduce fraud losses without introducing unnecessary friction for legitimate customers. Drive Product & AI/ML Execution: Co-own the fraud product roadmap with Data Science and ML Engineering teams. Directly inform and test next-generation models for real-time transaction monitoring, device fingerprinting, behavioral biometrics, and anomaly detection. Own Partner & Scheme Operational Compliance: Ensure operational adherence to fraud rules, monitoring programs, and threshold limits established by card schemes (Visa, Mastercard, local schemes), banking partners, and regulators across all active markets. Incident Management & Root Cause Remediation: Lead real-time response to complex or high-value fraud incidents. Conduct post-mortems, deploy immediate policy/rule fixes, and implement long-term structural remediations. Metrics & Loss Budget Ownership: Own operational KPIs, fraud loss performance against targets, False Positive Rates (FPR), triage SLAs, and chargeback recovery rates. Serve as the primary operational presenter on 1LoD performance to risk committees and leadership. Essentials 10+ years of hands-on Fraud Management experience in fintech, payment processing, acquiring, or modern banking infrastructure, with direct experience leading operational 1LoD teams and holding loss budget accountability. People Leadership: Proven track record of scaling, mentoring, and directing high-performing strategy and operational fraud teams in fast-paced environments. Deep Domain Expertise: Comprehensive operational knowledge of merchant acquiring fraud, card issuing fraud, CNP chargebacks, account takeover (ATO), and cross-border payment typologies. Card Scheme Mastery: Deep practical expertise in Visa/Mastercard dispute management, scheme monitoring programs (e.g., VFMP, VAMP, ECM), and payment gateway risk mechanics. Data & Technical Fluency: Hands-on experience working directly with complex data environments and decision engine tooling (SQL, Python/R, real-time risk platforms, rule engines). Cross-Functional Leadership: Demonstrated ability to drive operational execution across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Legal, 2LoD Risk, and external banking partners. Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @ airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page. Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary. Equal opportunity Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. title: Director, Antibody Discovery
description: About Relation Relation is a sector defining TechBio company developing transformational medicines, with technology at our core. Our ambition is to understand human biology in unprecedented ways, discovering therapies to treat some of life’s most devastating diseases. We leverage single-cell multi-omics from patient tissue, functional assays, and machine learning to drive disease understanding, from cause to cure. We are scaling rapidly and building a team of exceptional individuals to push the boundaries of drug discovery. You will work in highly interdisciplinary teams where biology, computation, and engineering come together to solve complex problems that have not been solved before. Our state-of-the-art wet and dry labs in the heart of London are designed to accelerate this integration and translate insight into impact. We are committed to building diverse and inclusive teams. Relation is an equal opportunities employer and does not discriminate on the basis of gender, sexual orientation, marital or civil partnership status, gender reassignment, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, disability, or age. By joining Relation, you will help define how medicines are discovered and deliver meaningful impact for patients. The opportunity Relation is offering an outstanding opportunity for a Director, Antibody Discovery to lead our antibody discovery function and help drive our growing biologics portfolio. This role will turn Relation’s patient-derived understanding of disease biology into differentiated antibody therapeutics, accelerating the journey from novel target to development candidate. As functional lead, you will lead a small, high-performing team of antibody scientists and drive the strategic build of Relation’s antibody capabilities — combining in-house platforms, computational and machine learning-enabled design, external partnerships and a carefully managed network of CROs to deliver high-quality molecules efficiently. Alongside this leadership remit, the role is deliberately hands-on: you will serve as the design lead on one or more drug discovery programmes, owning the molecular design strategy from project initiation, through hit identification and lead optimisation, to the nomination of a development candidate. Sitting within Relation’s Drug Discovery team, this position is deeply embedded within cross-functional matrix project teams and will support multiple disease areas as our portfolio grows. You will work closely with Target Biology, Machine Learning, Protein Sciences, in vivo Pharmacology, Translational Safety, DMPK and CMC to ensure that every molecule is designed with efficacy, safety, developability and manufacturability in mind. As the portfolio develops, you may also take accountability as Project Leader, leading a cross-functional team of scientists and owning the overall project strategy and delivery to development candidate. Your scope will span the full breadth of antibody formats, from monoclonal antibodies to bispecific and multi-specific molecules, antibody-drug conjugates and other engineered biologics. The role is a hybrid role based at our state-of-the-art facility in the heart of London. Day to day, you will Build and lead Relation’s antibody design function, recruiting, mentoring and developing a small team of antibody scientists, setting standards for scientific excellence and championing innovative approaches to drive data-informed decisions. Define and execute the strategy for building Relation’s antibody discovery capabilities, determining the right balance of in-house, partnered and outsourced activity, and evaluating and onboarding new technologies such as in vivo immunisation (including transgenic platforms), display libraries, single B-cell screening and computational / AI-enabled de novo design. Act as the hands-on antibody design lead on one or more drug discovery programmes, translating target biology and the target product profile into a molecular design strategy — including format, epitope, affinity, valency, mechanism of action and Fc engineering — from project initiation to development candidate. Prosecute antibody discovery campaigns end-to-end: antigen and reagent strategy, hit generation, hit triage and screening cascades, and lead optimisation through affinity maturation, humanisation, specificity profiling and cross-reactivity to toxicology species, culminating in candidate selection. Embed developability and manufacturability from the outset, using in silico and experimental assessment of sequence liabilities, biophysical properties, stability, expression and immunogenicity risk, and partnering with CMC to de-risk the path to the clinic. Integrate computational, structural and machine learning-enabled design into iterative design–make–test–learn cycles. Establish and manage CRO and external partner relationships, leading partner selection, scoping and contracting, and providing scientific oversight to ensure effective execution, clear prioritisation and delivery against timelines, budgets, quality and project goals. Where required, take accountability as Project Leader for a cross-functional project team, owning project strategy, integrated plans, budgets and risk management, and leading the team through governance milestones to development candidate nomination. Interface closely with cross-functional teams, including target biology, machine learning, protein sciences, structural biology, in vivo pharmacology, DMPK and clinical pharmacology, translational safety, CMC and IP, to ensure antibody candidates meet the target product profile. Contribute to intellectual property strategy and patent filings and author relevant sections of development candidate nomination packages and IND-enabling documentation. Translate complex antibody discovery and characterisation data into clear, actionable insights, communicating findings effectively to project teams, governance bodies and senior stakeholders. Champion Relation’s collaborative, ambitious and science-driven culture, sharing antibody discovery expertise across the team and helping build an outstanding drug discovery organisation. Professionally, you will have A PhD in Immunology, Protein Engineering, Biochemistry, Structural Biology, Molecular Biology or a related scientific discipline, or equivalent industry experience in a lead antibody discovery position. Significant experience in the pharmaceutical or biotech industry in antibody drug discovery, with a proven track record of prosecuting antibody programmes from project initiation through to development candidate nomination as the design or functional lead. Experience across multiple antibody formats, such as monoclonal, bispecific and multi-specific antibodies and antibody-drug conjugates, and experience leading cross-functional project teams would be highly beneficial. Deep, hands-on expertise in antibody discovery technologies (immunisation including transgenic platforms, phage / yeast / mammalian display, single B-cell technologies) and antibody engineering (humanisation, affinity maturation, Fc engineering, multi-specific format design), together with a strong grasp of developability assessment, biophysical and functional characterisation and screening cascade design. Familiarity with structure-based, computational and machine learning-enabled antibody design, and a sound understanding of the translational, safety and CMC requirements on the path to IND, is expected. A demonstrable ability to lead, motivate and develop a small team of scientists, together with experience building new capabilities and selecting, contracting and managing CROs and external partners to deliver against timelines and budgets. Outstanding communication skills, with a clear ability to translate complex scientific data into actionable strategic messages for cross-functional teams, stakeholders and senior leadership. Personally, you Are comfortable working in a matrixed environment, balancing multiple stakeholders and contributing effectively across teams. Take ownership of your work , proactively seek opportunities to contribute, and enable others to do their best work. Communicate openly and directly , give and receive feedback constructively, and handle challenging conversations with respect. Actively seek out diverse perspectives , build strong working relationships, and contribute to shared goals across teams. Embrace challenges with openness and resilience , set high standards for yourself, and strive to deliver meaningful outcomes. Working Style & Culture at Relation At Relation, we operate in a matrixed, interdisciplinary environment , where impact is driven through collaboration across scientific, technical, and operational domains. We collaborate, and you will partner with colleagues across multiple teams and projects, contributing your expertise while aligning to shared company priorities. We work together and win together! The patient is waiting! Recruitment Agencies Please note that Relation does not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies. Resumes should not be forwarded to our job aliases or employees. Relation will not be liable for any fees associated with unsolicited CVs. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

This team sits at the intersection of customer reality and model quality. We combine hands-on technical depth with strong product judgment, helping translate complex, high-value use cases into clear signals that can improve both the customer experience and the underlying systems. title: Technical Product Manager - Developer Experience (DevEx)
description: Our mission We're making Africa the first cashless continent. In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash. We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast. Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in... How you'll help us achieve it Your mission is to make it dramatically easier for our engineers to ship features and learn from them quickly, securely, and reliably. You'll aim for small-startup speed while meeting the quality bar of a large financial institution. Velocity here means removing friction and toil from the path between idea and learning, not asking people to work harder. AI is a big part of the opportunity, and we're looking for a PM who is optimistic about its possibilities but pragmatic about what actually works. The goal is not to adopt the latest shiny AI tool; it's to deeply understand your internal users, experiment, and honestly evaluate what solves their problems, whether that's AI, process changes, or boring tooling that just works. The Technical Product Manager - DevEx will: Lead a team of engineers with full ownership of how we deliver new features for our users and use AI solutions to remove impactful friction for our engineers and product managers. Define product goals, metrics, and roadmaps based on user needs and mission impact. Drive user research within our engineering and product teams. Write clear, compelling design docs and facilitate async, fast-moving decision-making. Over-communicate context, priorities, and decisions to ensure team alignment. Adjust priorities quickly based on feedback, experiments, or new learnings. Solve problems holistically, whether through product features, ops tooling or process changes. In this role, you'll... Own the developer experience holistically, including any internal or external tooling needed to support it. Research and implement solutions for how we can use AI to remove engineering and development friction. Build your own prototypes to test ideas where possible. Relentlessly gather feedback (by talking to users and looking at data) to deeply understand the problem space and our engineers' and product managers' needs. Work from first principles to understand the engineers' and product managers' biggest problems and then figure out how our tooling should work to solve those problems. Prioritize the biggest problems blocking the engineers' and product managers' productivity and the impact on delivering value to our users fast and securely. Directly manage the DevEx team to help them grow in their careers, partnering with the Tech Lead, who will own the technical bar. Key Details This is a fully remote role. Candidates must be based in one of our talent hub countries (UK, Spain, USA (East Coast), Canada, Kenya and Ghana) or in one of our operating markets in Africa including Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, or Burkina Faso Wave is a distributed team, and we fund up to three in-person get-togethers a year, in line with Wave's travel policy. Our salaries are competitive and are calculated using a transparent formula. For this role, depending on your level and location, we offer a salary up to $237,500 USD, plus a generous equity package. Major benefits: Subsidized health insurance for you and your dependents, and retirement contributions (both vary from country to country). 6 months of fully paid parental leave and subsidized fertility assistance. Flexible vacation, with most folks taking between 21-30 days per year. $10,000 annual charitable donation matching. Requirements Have 3+ years of product management experience and hands-on engineering background (you've shipped production code) or direct PM ownership of a developer experience, or developer productivity function. Proven success in overseeing all elements of the product development lifecycle, such as user research, design, implementation and evaluation. Speak fluent English Bonus if you: Have proven experience with successfully rolling out AI-based solutions in a larger org Have professional experience in a consumer fintech company You might be a good fit if you Resonate deeply with how we do product and have experience working that way. Are continuously iterating on using AI in real workflows with honest evaluation. Are a strong communicator who can inspire and lead by influence. Are great at coordinating across teams and excel at communicating across multiple cultures. Take ownership for outcomes and do whatever you can to make them close to inevitable. Have strong instincts for asking questions that could move the needle. Have the courage and persistence to replan when feedback or new information arrives. Always listen with empathy but ruthlessly prioritize based on impact. About Product at Wave Product has always been very important to us at Wave, starting from day one with two very strong product-minded founders. Product Managers play a central role in our organization, impacting large chunks of the company around them, similar to the founders they were shaped after years ago. Our approach to building products may not be what you've seen in other places. Our processes are lightweight, informed by principles instead of methodologies and our PMs don't just manage backlogs full of polished tickets. Read our write-up on product at Wave! If you're excited to own a real problem end-to-end, set your own goals, and guide a team toward outcomes that matter for real people, you'll feel right at home here. If that's you, we'd love to meet you. Our team We have a rapidly growing in-country team in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Mali, Burkina Faso, The Gambia, Uganda, Niger, Sierra Leone, and Cameroon plus remote team members spread across the world. We're deeply passionate about our mission of bringing radically affordable financial services to the people who need them most. We foster autonomy for our employees. You'll own your projects at every stage, from understanding the problem to monitoring your solution in production. We raised the largest Series A in Africa in 2021. Our world-class investors, include Founders Fund, Sequoia Heritage, Stripe, Ribbit Capital, Y Combinator, and Partech Africa. We are on Y Combinator's top companies by revenue . We review applications frequently and recommend that you apply to the role that most closely aligns with your skills, experience and career goals. Wave is an equal-opportunity employer. You'll play a key role in bringing media plans to life across platforms such as Meta and TikTok, monitoring performance, making data-led optimisations and reporting on campaign success.</p> <p data-pm-slice="1 3 []">The role sits within THG Beauty's Retail Media structure, working closely with brand marketing leads, buying, trading, performance marketing and creative teams to deliver impactful, brand-funded media campaigns.</p> <p>You'll act as an external-facing LOOKFANTASTIC ambassador and media specialist, building relationships with our brand partners and helping them maximise creative testing and optimisation.</li> <li>Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to build relationships and confidently present campaign recommendations to external brand title: Commercial
description: At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets. We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand. We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel. Read more about what we’re building here . This role is for someone who can drive go-to-market success and build a repeatable commercial motion as Axle grows. You’ll help customers adopt our technology, commercialise flexibility across their customer base, and expand usage over time. You’ll be expected to move quickly, remove friction, and adapt processes pragmatically rather than getting stuck in bureaucracy. We’re looking for someone with strong commercial instincts, a sharp GTM mindset, and the ability to operate comfortably in technical conversations. This role will own Winning new business Developing and managing our growing sales pipeline Go-to-market strategy and execution Client onboarding and ongoing commercial relationship management What you will be doing Defining sales at Axle, as we establish our go-to-market approach. You will have the ability to make an immediate contribution to our rapidly increasing revenue growth Owning new customer acquisition end-to-end, from first conversation through to commercial close, setting our partners up to generate meaningful revenue (bonus points if you can do this in multiple languages) Driving go-to-market execution with partners, including value propositions, pricing considerations, customer segmentation, and launch strategies Acting as a commercial bridge between partners and internal teams, translating market and customer insights into clear product, pricing, and GTM inputs Building and refine scalable sales and partner processes that support repeatable growth across different customer segments Tracking performance, pipeline, and outcomes, using data to prioritise effort and continuously improve commercial effectiveness What success looks like In your first 90 days: you’ll know our product and markets, have built your own pipeline of EV charging, battery and heat-pump partners, and closed your first deal By 6 months: several new partners signed and launched, generating revenue on our platform By 12 months: you own a customer segment end to end, and you’re ready to take on a new market or proposition Benefits A meaningful slice of equity in Axle, alongside a competitive salary, with total compensation ranging from £75k–£200k (base salary + equity). We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation. Enhanced parental leave to support you through life's meaningful moments. Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose. Hybrid working - We have a dog-friendly office around Farringdon. To maximize collaboration, we ask that you spend 2-3 days a week in the office. The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world. We are extremely keen to build a diverse company, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’. Interview process Initial interview Take-home exercise Final interview (in-person) Offer, references, and welcome to the team! title: Sr. Escalation Engineer
description: Onwards Together! Illumio is the leader in ransomware and breach containment, redefining how organizations contain cyberattacks and enable operational resilience. Powered by the Illumio AI Security Graph, our breach containment platform identifies and contains threats across hybrid multi-cloud environments – stopping the spread of attacks before they become disasters. Recognized as a Leader in the Forrester Wave™ for Microsegmentation, Illumio enables Zero Trust, strengthening cyber resilience for the infrastructure, systems, and organizations that keep the world running. Our Team's Vision: Support exists to help customers operate with confidence . We provide expert technical guidance that keeps customers’ Illumio environments secure, resilient, and performing at their best. Our role extends far beyond resolving support cases - we help customers maintain confidence in one of the most critical components of their cybersecurity strategy. Our engineers solve complex technical challenges, collaborate closely with Product Engineering to improve the platform, identify opportunities to strengthen the customer experience, and partner with Customer Success and Professional Services to ensure customers achieve lasting success. Every interaction is an opportunity to deepen customer trust and reinforce the value of their investment in Illumio. Joining Support means becoming part of a collaborative organization that values technical excellence, continuous learning, operational discipline, and customer advocacy. If you’re passionate about solving difficult problems, working across teams, and helping customers succeed in their cybersecurity journey, you’ll have the opportunity to make a measurable difference for customers around the world. Your Impact: You will work with industry leading customers in maintaining Illumio’s technology deployments You will be responsible for logging and updating cases, informing customers of the case status and providing solution(s) as they become known, in a professional, timely manner, over the lifetime of the support request Escalation Engineers need to understand customer systems and configurations. Analyze problems/defects and recommend solutions Be able to work closely with external customers, other support engineers, Development, Sales and others as needed, to gain knowledge and provide solutions Ability to set customer expectations appropriately and accurately Provide technical product support to field engineers and technicians for complex problems on company products. May interact with customer and company personnel to isolate and fix product issues Provide design, reliability and other technical feedback to R&D Handle escalations to R&D as needed Provides updates to technical product documentation as issues are identified and fixed Create tests and diagnostic tools to identify and fix recurring issues as well as potential difficulties Always interacts with customers directly via email, phone and remote analysis tools. Act as the primary communication contact dealing with customer issues Requirement gathering for new product feature requests from the field Populates content and updates to the company knowledge base for both internal and external users Assists product and account teams when delivering and implementing and testing new product features for specific customers Assists internal field teams whenever a pre-sales issue is reported through to engineering Your Toolkit: Experience as a Technical Support Engineer working with Support and Services functions such as case management and call resolution management Experience with public cloud infrastructure and services A drive to solve practical business problems with client-centric solutions A high attention to detail Strong organizational, problem-solving and systems analysis skills Strong written and verbal communication skills Enjoy learning new technologies, applications, and systems An enthusiastic self-starter with a commitment to learning, customer empathy, and team communication Deep understanding of NF-Tables, IPrule and IPsets Understanding of PKI / CA Experience working in the security space Fluent in English and another European language (Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese) Bonus Points: Good understanding of modern programming languages, web services, and databases: Ruby, Python, Jupyter Notebook, REST API, SQL, etc. Experience with knowledge management framework and writing KB articles Public cloud certification: AWS, Azure, etc. Experience and/or certification in Container Orchestration (Kubernetes, OpenShift, etc.) #LI-SL1 #LI-Hybrid Our Commitment Illumio believes that an environment of unique backgrounds, experiences, viewpoints, and individual contributions creates a culture of belonging, drives our future, and makes us stronger together in support of our customers and their success. title: Value Consultant
description: About hyperexponential (hx) At hyperexponential, we’re building the AI-powered platform that enables the world’s most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry: which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms. Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We’re changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision. We help them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence. Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we’re scaling globally. We are already trusted by nearly 50 of the world’s largest insurers, with near zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx. What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do, from building the world’s first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates. What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn’t tied to title or tenure. It’s defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you’ll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company built to endure. If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next. About the Value Consulting team The Pricing & Innovation team helps customers get the most from hx Renew, our market-leading SaaS pricing platform, and helps prospects and customers understand the value hx can create across pricing, underwriting and AI. Within it, Value Consulting turns complex customer problems into clear business cases, analysis and value stories that support better commercial decisions. The team sits at the heart of our go-to-market motion, building the business cases and ROI stories that unlock strategic enterprise opportunities and drive adoption, expansion and long-term growth. You will work as a bridge between Sales, Product, Customer Success and senior customer stakeholders, turning ambiguous problems into quantified value stories that strengthen commercial conversations. We are a small, high-ownership team. The culture is analytical, commercially minded and highly collaborative, with a strong expectation of independence, learning agility and comfort operating without a fully established playbook. What you’ll be doing Build clear, data-driven business cases and ROI models that quantify the financial impact of hx for prospects and customers, helping them make confident buying decisions. Partner with Sales on strategic enterprise opportunities, getting involved early to shape tailored value narratives that accelerate deal cycles and increase win rates. Run value workshops with stakeholders from junior underwriters to actuarial, pricing, transformation and executive leaders. Develop benchmarking, ROI analysis and customer insight that give Sales and senior leaders compelling proof points for executive-level conversations. Translate complex customer problems, workflows and data into simple, credible value stories. Build the reusable models, benchmarks and templates that let Account Executives run a first-pass value case themselves on standard deals, so your time goes to the deals that need your judgement. Continuously refine how we work, using AI and other tools to improve efficiency and impact. What you’ll need to have done Built robust business cases or ROI models for a technical or data-driven product, using clear assumptions and logic to demonstrate measurable commercial impact, that a buyer used to make a decision. Presented numbers to a sceptical commercial or technical audience and held your ground when challenged. Taken messy data and ambiguous customer problems through to clear, actionable recommendations, without close direction. Translated complex quantitative analysis into simple, executive-ready stories or presentations that have influenced decision makers. Worked cross-functionally with Sales, Product and Customer Success (or similar teams) to align on value drivers, messaging and success criteria. Pushed back when a number was being stretched, because the case needed to be right. You’re unlikely to thrive here if You prefer highly defined, static playbooks and feel uncomfortable operating in ambiguity or helping to build the motion as you go. You are not motivated by digging into the details of financial models, customer data and assumptions to create credible, defensible analysis. You find it difficult to challenge or influence senior stakeholders, or you avoid direct collaboration with Sales on commercial outcomes. If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you'll do your best work. We're building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us. Compensation At hx, we’re committed to salary transparency. You’ll always have clarity on pay early in the process. Our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations, and we’re working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally. Because we’re building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don’t always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that’s competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make. Equity: We offer equity across all roles at hx, making it a significant component of total compensation. Your Talent Partner will be able to share more details about this. Benefits £5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development. 25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total). Company pension scheme via Penfold. Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life . Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno. Private healthcare insurance through AXA. Income protection and Life Insurance. Cycle to Work Scheme. Additional perks Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.). Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights. Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry. Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together. Interview process Initial call with our Talent team (30 minutes) Hiring Manager interview (1 hour) Skills assessment (1 hour) Values interview (1 hour) Meet the CEO Our commitment to Diversity hxers are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive. Diversity is not just the right thing to do; it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure. If you’re energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team. Next steps If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome. For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, you can visit our careers page. Please note that background checks will be conducted as part of the hiring process to ensure compliance with our governance policies. We handle all background checks sensitively and in full compliance with relevant regulations. All applicant data will be processed in accordance with data protection regulations and our privacy policy. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Sales Manager - UK&I
description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the Role As Sales Manager, UK&I, you own the territory at the strategic level, customer relationships, the policy work that opens and secures the path to contract, and the order intake. Your capture manager owns the field; you own the direction, the arbitration and the number. Responsibilities Own the territory plan: customer and programme mapping, budget lines, competitive picture, prioritised pursuits, path to contract for each. Build and hold relationships at senior and institutional level: ministries of defence, procurement agencies, service headquarters and end-user commands. Shape requirements, acquisition routes and budget line placement ahead of formal competition. Decide what we pursue and what we walk away from, and defend those calls. Own pipeline hygiene, forecast accuracy and a defensible probability on every opportunity. Set the commercial rhythm across the territory: demonstrations, trials, exercises and industry events, with Marketing and your capture manager. Carry and deliver an annual order intake target. Lead and grow the territory team. Requirements +5-10 years selling complex defence systems to state customers, the majority of it in UK&I. An existing, live, senior-level network in the territory. This is the first filter — without current high-level access in your market, this is not the right role. Ownership of at least one full path to contract, from requirement shaping through acquisition route to signature. A demonstrable record of influencing a requirement or acquisition strategy before a formal competition existed. Experience running captures with local industrial partners, and fluency in national procurement regulation, documentation and local-content constraints. A track record of carrying and hitting an order intake number in a fast-moving or resource-constrained environment. Line management experience, or clear readiness for it. Native or fully professional command of at least one core language of the territory. Eligible for national security clearance in the territory, and willing to go through the process. Willing to travel intensively across the territory. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI. If you're energised by a fast-moving landscape and finding the signal in the noise, this is your chance to help shape what comes next. The job, unfiltered: Own the content strategy and roadmap end to end across evergreen, seasonal and intent-led content, prioritising by business impact rather than volume, and shape the approach for Rated People as we rebuild the brand so it grows alongside Checkatrade without competing for the same demand. Confidence working directly in the data: pulling and interpreting GSC, Ahrefs and crawler data (such as Screaming Frog or Sitebulb) yourself rather than relying on pre-built dashboards. A track record of owning projects from problem to measurable outcome without close oversight. Experience managing freelancers or agencies, with a structured approach to briefing, reviewing and developing writers. Off-site SEO and digital PR experience, including campaigns that built topical authority and working with PR teams to brief in SEO requirements and measure impact. A working understanding of GEO/AEO and how content surfaces in generative search, hands-on experience with (or a strong appetite for) AI and agentic workflows, and clear communication with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior stakeholders.
