title: Business Lead - Pitstops
description: Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction . Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people , making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone. THE TEAM • ~160 people , around half in engineering, product and data • 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research • Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle • An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking , tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation The opportunity Pitstops are the local shops that power Relay. Every day, thousands of corner shops, newsagents and convenience stores take in parcels from our vans, hand them to couriers on bikes and in cars, and serve customers dropping off and picking up. They’re the reason we can deliver faster and cheaper than the big carriers. We’ve grown from a few hundred pitstops to thousands in two years. Next is the rest of the UK and the US. This role owns making that network work. That means the right pitstops, at a pay that works for them and for us. When one goes wrong, you see it the same day in parcels left behind and routes running late. You’ll build the systems that stop that happening, and fix it fast when it does. About the role Pitstop capacity vs required. Enough active, open pitstops with headroom in each zone. Working with the sales team to close capacity gaps as we grow and expand and the data team to model how our capacity will grow and change as we make it easier to work with us. Undelivered and uncollected parcels on PUDO routes. The daily rate, and how fast it’s recovered. You own the strategy for the automated processes and app flows that drive it down. Pitstop pricing economics. Pay per bag and scan, and the target rate by area, understanding how this impacts our contribution margin as a business. Activation throughput. Getting signed pitstops live and up to speed as fast as possible. We’ve grown from a few hundred pitstops to thousands in two years. Now we need to do that across the UK and in the US. What you’ll do Lead pitstop strategy and metrics. Turn the outcomes above into the parts you can control, a roadmap and named owners. Work with Engineering and Data to deliver it. Hold a weekly results review: what we expected, what happened, what we do next. Own delivery-today and recovery for pitstops. Rejections, closures, caps and redirects. Make sure each failure type has a playbook and an owner, and track how often recovery works. Replace scrappy manual processes with automated systems, fast. Own pricing. Find opportunities for pricing experiments, such as variable rates. Set guardrails and rollback triggers. Recommend rates by area, ensuring we stay in line with competitors. Work with Commercial, who own the rate quoted at signing. Make Relay easy to run alongside a shop. Pitstops are small businesses working with us on the side of their main trade. Every scan, bag and app screen costs them time. Understand what it’s like to be a pitstop. Remove friction from their day, and make sure the volume and pay they get from us stay worth it. What you’ll need Ownership. You run outcomes, not tasks. A good week is one where the metrics you own move the right way, quickly. Comfort with data. You can read a dashboard, question a number and frame an experiment. SQL is a plus, not a must. Ops judgement. You know when to fix today’s problem and when to fix the system behind it. A bias to automate. You’d rather build the system once than do the same task twice. You ship a rough first version fast, then improve it. Whatever you design has to work at ten times today’s size. Influence. You get work done through teams you don’t manage, and you write things down so knowledge is shared. Experience. Operations, marketplace or commercial roles in logistics, delivery or similar networks. Who Thrives at Relay? Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously. Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction. 1% Better Every Day : You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience. All In, All the Time : You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts. People-Powered Greatness : You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success. Grow the Whole Pie : You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we. If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect. title: Junior Software Developer
description: The Software Developer I, Connector role supports Trial Interactive’s proprietary platform, Connector - the cloud-based integrations that move life science data between clients’ clinical systems (for example EDC/eCRF and IRT systems) and Trial Interactive’s life science products. Working under the guidance of senior engineers, the role helps build and maintain connectors, keeps client data flowing accurately, and resolves issues when it does not. This is a blended role, covering development and maintenance up until handling client requests. This role works closely with the Solutions, DevOps and Engineering teams. DESCRIPTION As part of the Development and maintenance responsibility, the resource handles: • Develop, test and maintain connector components in C# on .NET (AWS Lambda), including the parsers and mappers that convert source-system data (API payloads, files) into the formats required by the Trial Interactive CTMS and eTMF. • Configure and extend mappings for new studies, sites and visit/status definitions on existing connectors, reusing existing modules wherever possible. • Assist in the technical onboarding of new clients and studies: connector configuration, test runs in non-production environments, and verification before go-live. • Work with the AWS services connectors are built on (Lambda, SQS, S3, EventBridge/Step Functions, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch) and make small, reviewed infrastructure changes using Terraform under supervision. • Consume, test and troubleshoot REST APIs (client/vendor APIs and Trial Interactive import APIs) using code and tools such as Postman, and help extend APIs that improve connector stability and connectivity. • Write unit and functional tests; use Git (feature branches, merge requests, environment branches) and follow the team’s code review and release process. • Keep code, configuration and change records documented so that others can maintain them. • Work on special projects, such as local test environments using LocalStack. As part of handling Client communication, support and ticket resolution, the resource does: • Own assigned support tickets from triage to closure: reproduce the issue, investigate, fix or escalate, and record the outcome in the ticketing system (for example Jira, ServiceDesk Plus). • Investigate data issues end to end – trace a record from the source payload through the archive, parser, connector database and logs to its CTMS/eTMF import result – and establish the root cause (RCA) with evidence. • Reconcile source-system data against the CTMS/eTMF when a client reports missing or mismatched subjects, visits or statuses, and explain any differences. • Communicate with clients and Solutions Engineers by email, tickets and calls: acknowledge requests promptly, ask clear clarifying questions, give regular status updates, and explain findings and next steps in plain language. • Monitor connector health (CloudWatch logs, failed imports, notifications) and respond to failures within agreed response times. • Escalate appropriately to senior engineers, DevOps or the vendor, with a concise summary of what happened, when, in which environment and for which records. • Write up RCAs, fixes and known issues so that repeat problems are resolved faster, and help keep support documentation current. • Handle client and clinical data with care: use the minimum data needed, never share one client’s information with another, and follow Trial Interactive data-protection and change-control procedures. General • Keep learning the connector platform, the clinical-trial data domain and cloud and software development best practices. • Complete all other tasks that are deemed appropriate for this role and assigned by the manager/supervisor. title: Lead Product Designer
description: Lead Product Designer 📍 Manchester (Hybrid, up to 4 days WFH) 💰 £70k-£90k (negotiable) Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK. We want to be the leading creator of delightful experiences for everybody involved in buying, selling, renting and letting property, regardless of their involvement, to improve the industry for everybody by elevating UK Estate Agencies through world-class technology. We're now looking for a Lead Product Designer - the most senior individual contributor for design within a product domain. This is predominantly an IC role: you'll set the design bar for an entire domain through the quality of your own work, the patterns you contribute, and the way you raise the designers around you. We're flexible on this for the right person, if you've got management experience, or want to line-manage one or two designers alongside the IC work, let's talk. We want someone who is tired of the "feature factory" grind, who is past needing to be told what's worth working on, and who is ready to set the design direction for a domain in one of the most exciting PropTech companies in the UK. If you look at most UX job ads, you see a laundry list of requirements. We prefer to tell you how we actually operate so you can decide if this is the right environment for you. At Street Group, design is a strategic seat. Lead Product Designers drive roadmap conversations alongside their product and engineering counterparts, not respond to them. Our users rely on us to run their businesses, so they love talking to us. You can spin up a call and validate a prototype instantly. We don't guess; we ask. We move at pace, including on strategic work. Strategy isn't a separate, slower track here - we test it by shipping. Here's what you can expect to be working on as an L6 Lead Product Designer at Street Group Own the design vision and execution for a product domain. Translate strategic direction into the most ambiguous, cross-cutting, or strategically important pieces of design work. Set the craft bar through your own output. The work you ship is the reference point for what good looks like in your area. Own the cross-cutting design problems: patterns across multiple features, flows across multiple surfaces, the coherence of the domain's experience as a whole. Mentor and raise the bar of the designers around you - through critique, pairing, and modelling what excellent design looks like. Drive AI thinking strategically - both in your own workflow (Claude Code, in-product changes, prototype testing) and in what we ship to users. You'll have a strong view on what makes a good AI feature in this domain vs a gimmicky one. Why you should (and shouldn't) apply You should apply if: You've operated at senior IC level in a modern product org and you want broader scope to influence what gets built. You're commercially fluent. You've made design trade-offs informed by how the product makes money, not just by user preference. You can name those trade-offs and defend them either way. You define what success looks like before you ship, and you read the result against it after. Metrics, support data, customer feedback - you go and look. You have strong, well-formed views on AI in product design and have put them into practice. You can articulate when AI is the right design solution and when it isn't. You move at pace on strategic work, not just on features. You probably shouldn't apply if: You're looking for the next pay band up from Senior with broadly similar expectations. This is not a "Senior+" role. Lead expects materially more scope, autonomy, judgment, and ownership of outcomes. You've never shipped design work where you defined a success measure upfront and checked the result afterwards. We need someone who already operates that way. You've never had to make a commercial trade-off - design that's user-optimal but expensive to build, or design that doesn't move retention. You'd struggle to explain how AI is changing what you ship, not just how you work. AI fluency is non-negotiable at this level. You expect to be handed a brief. At L6 you identify what's worth doing and bring the case for it. A bit about you Experience: Roughly 8+ years of Product/UX Design experience, with a track record at senior IC level. SaaS or complex product experience is strongly preferred. Outcomes, not artefacts: You can point to design work you've shipped where you wrote the success measure upfront and read the result after release. You know what worked, what didn't, and what you'd do differently. Commercial fluency: You understand how the products you've worked on make money and you've made trade-offs informed by that. AI: Comfortable using AI across your workflow and equally comfortable thinking strategically about AI in the products you design - what makes a good AI feature, what the failure modes are, what to build now vs later. Craft: Your work is exemplary and you can articulate it clearly enough to teach. You have views on interaction quality, hierarchy, motion, microcopy - and you can defend them. Cross-functional: Comfortable as a peer at the table with product and engineering counterparts in your domain. Drive direction; don't wait for it. Open to flex: This is predominantly an IC role, but we're not rigid about it. If you've line-managed before, or want to take on one or two direct reports alongside the IC work, we're open to that conversation. Research has shown that women tend to rule themselves out of applying for jobs unless they meet 100% of the requirements. If you fall into that category and are about to rule yourself out based on the above criteria, please consider applying anyway. We'd love to see your application. Why join Street Group? 🏠 Hybrid-working - you can work from home up to 4 days per week 🏖️ Guilt-Free R&R - £1000 towards a holiday after your first year with the team (we'll even cover the tax!) 💪 Joining a culture that supports your development and encourages growth 📚 £500 yearly L&D budget for your career development 🎂 Your birthday on us - we pay, you stay away 🙋 'Give something back' - 2 paid days volunteering on us 👶 Enhanced maternity, paternity & adoption pay 🧠 Mental health & well-being support via Health Assured 🧘 Regular well-being initiatives 🕒 Flexible working hours 🚂 Public transport season ticket loans 🌷 Paid menopause leave 🌞 Holiday buying scheme 🚀 Joining a new team in an exciting business with huge ambition 👥 Be a part of something bigger - everyone in our team is passionate about improving the entire property industry! It's a huge goal, but it motivates us to do better every single day 👩🏿‍💻 A chance to work on cutting-edge technology 🐶 Comfortable, relaxed office space - office dogs welcome! 🍻 Fully stocked fridge and beers (or an alternative) on us every Friday afternoon 🎊 Company and team off-sites, events and happy hours 🚴 Cycle to work scheme 🚗 Electric car salary sacrifice scheme 🌍 Feel good about sustainability - we're a climate-positive company! Salary We don't have a fixed band published for this role yet - it'll be calibrated based on your experience and scope. Please apply and let's have the conversation. We care deeply about helping the tech industry become a more inclusive and diverse place and we work hard to lead by example. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a complementary team of employees and building an inclusive environment for all. Candidates must be eligible to live and work in the UK and be able to perform the work specified. Interview Process 4 stages = An introductory call with one of our Talent team > Technical Interview inc a design task with our Head of UX > Final interview with our Co-Founder/Head of Product. We want to make our interviews as inclusive as possible, so if you need any adjustments made or if there's anything you think we should be aware of during the interview process, please do let us know. A note on using AI in your job application As a fast-moving and rapidly evolving tech company, we embrace the advantages of AI and encourage its use throughout our application process. However, our goal is to get to know and hire the authentic you - your skills, experience, and values. We don't want to hire an AI-generated version of you. We consider AI to be a valuable tool, not something that should overshadow you as an individual Compensation: £70K – £90K L6 • £70K – £90K Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Product Manager
description: Menlo Security is the leader in Browser Security for human and agentic workforces. Our mission is to enable humans and agents to connect, communicate, and collaborate securely, without compromise. The Menlo Browser Security Platform protects organizations from cyberattacks by stopping threats across the web, documents, and email before they reach the user. With Menlo Agent Runtime Security (MARS), that protection now extends to the AI agents working alongside every employee. Menlo Security is trusted by major global businesses, including Fortune 500 companies and government agencies, to protect their most valuable asset, their data, and is backed by top-tier investors. About the Role Summary Menlo Security is building MARS for Agents (Menlo Agent Runtime Security), our product line for securing autonomous and hybrid AI agents. This is a category still being defined — standards, architecture patterns, and competitive positioning are all forming in real time, with competitors ranging from established network security vendors to a wave of new agent-security startups. We are hiring an experienced Product Manager / Product Owner to take end-to-end ownership of a significant, technically complex area within MARS for Agents. The specific scope will be defined in partnership with the hiring manager based on team needs and the background of the person in this role, and will span identity and security concepts, relevant technical protocols, and platform integration and partnership work. The role operates with a high degree of autonomy day to day, working from strategic direction set by the Head of Product, in an environment that runs agile development at high velocity while actively building the process and rigor needed to scale a growing product line. This is also a team that works the way it builds: AI assistants and LLM-based tools are part of the daily toolkit here — used to synthesize customer and competitive signal, pressure-test requirements, and prototype against MCP clients and agent runtimes before a single line of production code is written. The person in this role will be defining security for a category they are already a fluent, curious user of. Outcomes & KPIs Key Outcome(s) Owned: End-to-end ownership of an assigned surface area of MARS for Agents — across capabilities such as the agent registry, Claude integration, Microsoft Copilot integration, MCP Server, MCP Proxy, and LLM proxy — from researched opportunity, to written requirement, to shipped and supported capability. title: Staff Frontend Engineer
description: About Motorway Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding. This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better. We're looking for a Staff Frontend Engineer to help lead technically across our frontend engineering. You'll work across a group of cross-functional squads, each made up of engineers, designers, data analysts and a product manager, helping them move quickly and safely, resolving the engineering problems that span teams before they compound into systemic risk, and shaping product and business strategy with a technically-grounded, commercially-aware point of view. We're a TypeScript-first organisation. Our frontend stack is TypeScript and React, styled with SCSS, server-side rendered with Next.js and Express, and tested with Vitest & Chromatic. As a Staff engineer you'll bring deep expertise with the latest native web technologies and modern frameworks, drive consistency across all of our web properties, and lead the migration efforts that keep our stack current, not just bumping versions, but making use of the new capabilities each release brings and helping the wider department do the same. At Motorway, we know the importance of delivering high-quality, valuable solutions quickly, and we recognise the ability for AI tools and agents to accelerate our work. We provide our engineers with access to the latest models through Kiro. As a Staff engineer you'll define and lead our AI engineering practice on the frontend, setting standards for agent execution environments, quality harnesses, and guardrail architecture - and build a team norm where domain depth, AI-enabled breadth, and rigorous feedback-loop design are treated as complementary. What you'll be doing Ship features end to end : Own meaningful pieces of product work from design handoff through to production, building accessible, performant components, wiring them into applications, and shipping them with confidence. Author the contracts and the roadmap : Author and own API contracts and documentation for the department, and maintain a technical roadmap with rigorous written framing - precise intent, explicit trade-offs, and unambiguous success criteria - setting the documentation and spec-writing standard for the area. Drive consistency and lead migrations : Drive consistency across all our web properties, design the standards the department builds on, and lead migration efforts - making full use of new framework features and bringing the rest of engineering along with you. Own quality, security, performance and reliability standards : Set and maintain the security & web performance standards for the frontend, including client-side concerns like CSP, CWV, XSS prevention, data, governance plus reliability standards, incident review culture, and production readiness criteria. Own the build and deployment story : Understand the build and deployment pipeline for our assets and services end to end, monitor and improve it, and make informed, commercially-aware decisions about hosting providers, vendors, and build-vs-buy trade-offs. Develop other engineers : Develop IC3 engineers into technical leaders, raise the technical bar in hiring by defining what "good" looks like in the discipline, and build a culture of ownership, accountability, and high standards. Lead AI-assisted engineering : Use Kiro and other AI tools to move faster, and set the standards for how the team integrates AI into its everyday workflow and its products. What you'll have Minimum requirements At least 5+ years of experience in focused frontend practice building and operating production web applications at scale, with a track record of leading large, complex projects. The ability to bridge engineering and product fluently, translating between business priorities and technical constraints in both directions, and to make and defend difficult technical decisions under uncertainty through reasoning, not authority. Recognised as a technical authority in frontend engineering - engineers and product stakeholders seek you out for technical direction, and your judgement shapes decisions beyond your immediate team. Deep expertise with modern CSS/SCSS, HTML, and current ECMAScript proposals, and a strong understanding of the trade-offs between different frameworks and the scenarios in which each is the right choice. Comprehensive experience writing unit and E2E tests, and building the CI workflows to exercise them. Deep working knowledge of TypeScript and modern React (hooks, component composition, transitions), and of frameworks like Next.js that handle SSR, routing, and data fetching. Deep experience with observability, Core Web Vitals, accessibility auditing, and frontend performance tuning - and the ability to evaluate new frameworks and identify where we gain an edge in development, deployment, rendering, integration, and performance. Breadth across different teams, and the judgement to make pragmatic build-vs-refactor-vs-replace calls informed by a track record of production crises and scale challenges. A genuine interest in leading AI-assisted development as part of your and the team's workflow. Additional or preferred requirements Experience owning and maintaining a design system, and driving its adoption across multiple teams. The ability to create sensible UI designs without a Designer for non-trivial (though not highly complex) work when the team is resource-constrained. Experience evaluating vendors and third-party tools, and making build-vs-buy recommendations with clear technical and commercial criteria. Experience maintaining and evolving complex legacy systems at scale. Backend fluency - you don't need to be full-stack, but you're comfortable following a request deep into the API layer and shaping the contract on both sides. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Customer Success Lead
description: 💬 Accurx is solving healthcare productivity for the NHS. For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. At Accurx, we’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that helps every patient get gold-standard, efficient, and joined-up care. What started as a way for GPs to text a patient has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices. Our platform now powers Total Triage to manage patient demand, and Self-Book , which lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe , our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time. We’re not just shipping features. We’re giving clinicians their time back and ensuring every patient journey is as smooth as it should be. That sounds cool - what does a Customer Success Lead have to do with it? Accurx works with 41 of the 42 NHS ICBs and is growing fast in secondary care. To keep up with how the NHS is organising itself, our Account Management team has just moved to a regional model, with leads for London, the South and the North. The goal is simple: join up what we’re learning across primary care, secondary care, acute, community and mental health, and make sure the best opportunities get surfaced across the whole of England, not just in one set of ICBs. We’re hiring a Customer Success Lead for the North. You’ll lead a team of Customer Success Managers across primary and secondary care and be the strategic, zoomed-out view of the region. Your team is close to the accounts. Your job is to spot the patterns across them, turn what they’re hearing into strategy, and help Accurx show up at a regional level. The challenges you’ll solve as a Customer Success Lead Lead and grow a team of CSMs. You’ll start with three CSMs, each with their own region, customers and stage of the customer journey. You’ll coach them, unblock them and help them do the best work of their careers. Bring two very different care settings together. Primary care is about deepening trust we’ve built over years. Secondary care is about firsts: new services, longer implementations and goalposts that move. You’ll work out what connects them, what doesn’t, and where learnings from one can speed up the other. Turn insight into strategy. Your team will feed you what’s happening on the ground. You’ll spot trends, gaps and duplicated effort across the region and turn them into projects, goals and growth opportunities in products like Accurx Scribe and Total Triage. Own the commercial picture for your region. You’ll keep a close eye on churn, risk, renewals and upsell across your team’s accounts, and represent the region at our weekly business reviews with the exec team. Build the playbook with your fellow leads. The regional model is brand new. Alongside the leads for London and the South, you’ll shape how we work, what best practice looks like and how we scale it. Be the link across the business. You’ll work closely with implementation, transformation, support and business development, making sure the voice of our customers shapes where Accurx goes next. You should apply if... You’ve led customer-facing teams. You have a few years of people management in customer success or account management, and you love helping others grow. You’ve built things from the ground up. You’ve been on a startup to scale-up journey, worn a lot of hats, and taken customers from never having heard of you to being your biggest advocates. You care about depth, not volume. You’ve looked after long-standing, strategic relationships rather than a high-volume queue, and you know that trust is what makes customers stick. You can zoom out. You don’t need to be in the weeds of every account. You’re great at spotting patterns, asking the right questions and knowing where your team needs you most. You’re comfortable with ambiguity. You’re happy to try something, get it wrong, learn and go again. Process is something you create, not something you wait for. You’re a big collaborator. You’re an incredible communicator and listener, and you know the best outcomes come from working across teams. You’re curious about the NHS. Healthcare experience is welcome but not essential. What matters is empathy for the pressure the NHS is under and the patience to build trust in a complex system. What’s in it for you? You’ll join a high-performing team on a mission to solve healthcare productivity, building a platform used by around 300k NHS staff every week, supporting the care of over 50 million NHS patients every year. We set a high bar, move fast, and give people the ownership and support to do the best work of their careers £70,000 - £90,000 salary, plus a discretionary recognition bonus for exceptional performance and impact, nominated by managers and awarded by our leadership team Equity: £30,000 in equal share options, so you share in the value you help create Benefits to suit you: adjust your healthcare cover, your pension or life insurance, whatever stage you’re at in life Built for collaboration: We are an office-first culture and ask that you’re in our (dog-friendly) Shoreditch office for a minimum of 3 days a week Close to our users: Regular hackathons, plus dedicated time to visit GP practices and other healthcare settings to see first-hand how our products are used Time off: You’ll get 28 days of holiday (plus bank holidays) and up to 4 weeks to work from anywhere per year Support at home: We offer enhanced parental leave, fertility support and parental loss support We have our very own chefs: Free healthy breakfasts, snacks and lunches, plus a weekly sweet treat Compensation: £70K – £90K • £70K – £90K Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Work with specialist teams to test ideas responsibly, understand their impact and help the team adopt what works.</li> <li><strong>Making good decisions with data.</strong> Use pipeline, conversion, activation, productivity and quality data to understand where the team is doing well and where customers or opportunities are getting stuck. Keep the pipeline accurate and work with RevOps on reporting and forecasting.</li> <li><strong>Working as one team.</strong> Bring frontline insight to RevOps, Product, Marketing and Operations. Help shape the tools, processes and customer journeys Sales needs, and work together to solve problems that affect your team and customers.</li> <li><strong>Earning customers’ trust.</strong> Build a culture that puts customers first. Coach your team to understand their needs, represent Monzo accurately and deliver good outcomes. Raise concerns early and work with Risk, Compliance and Legal when needed.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></h3> <ul> <li>You’ve managed and developed a sales team. You can share examples of how you’ve coached individuals, given feedback and improved performance, including when conversations were difficult.</li> <li>You understand selling to small and medium-sized businesses in a relatively high-volume environment. You can balance an efficient process with thoughtful, customer-focused conversations.</li> <li>You’re a builder. You’ve spotted a problem in how a team sells, tried a better approach and helped people put it into practice. You’re comfortable making progress when the playbook is still being written.</li> <li>You’ve actively experimented with AI or automation at work and are keen to explore what agents and new workflows can do. You can tell us what you tried, the problem you were solving and what you learned.</li> <li>You’re happy to stay hands-on with customers. You enjoy sales conversations yourself and use what you learn to help others improve.</li> <li>You use data to understand performance. You can look at a funnel or pipeline, ask good questions and turn the answers into practical action.</li> <li>You work well with people in different teams. You can explain what your team and customers need, share evidence and help colleagues find solutions together.</li> <li>You care about doing the right thing for customers. You’re comfortable working within clear standards and learning what it takes to sell in a regulated environment.</li> <li>You might have built your experience in financial services, technology or another business selling to businesses. Read our <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">full list of benefits</a>.</p> <h4><strong>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></h4> <ul> <li>30-minute introductory call with a recruiter</li> <li>A full interview loop covering role-specific skills, behaviours and values</li> <li>A conversation with a member of the team</li> <li>Final interview with the hiring manager at our London office</li> </ul> <p>We’ll share more details about the interview process and timing as you progress. description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About AlphaSense: </strong></h2> <p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit <span><a href="http://www.alpha-sense.com" target="_blank">www.alpha-sense.com</a></span>. Come join us.</span></p></div><h3>Reporting to: SVP, Corporate Sales - EMEA & APAC</h3> <h3>About The Role:</h3> <p>The EMEA Sales Director, Life Science role is based in the UK, supporting our rapid expansion and recent product launches. In this role, you will:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Inspire and Lead</strong>: As a champion of AlphaSense’s culture and values, you’ll lead a high-performing, diverse team, setting a standard of excellence across EMEA. Embracing our “Better Never Stops” philosophy, you’ll cultivate continuous improvement through strategic coaching, constructive feedback, and development to elevate team potential.</li> <li><strong>Drive Impact</strong>: Foster excellence through developing our people, perfecting our sales operations and optimising processes to exceed our ambitious sales targets. Leverage new product innovations to unlock opportunities and enhance value for new and existing clients, positioning AlphaSense as a trusted market partner.</li> <li><strong>Collaborate for Success</strong>: Partner in a cross-functional environment, working closely with product, marketing, and customer success teams to align on goals, execute collaboratively, and elevate client experiences. By setting clear, shared objectives and encouraging co-ownership, you’ll contribute to a unified approach organisation-wide.</li> </ul> <p>This is an extraordinary opportunity to make a meaningful impact during a period of rapid expansion.</p> <h3>Key Responsiibilties</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Team Leadership & Development</strong>: Build, inspire, and lead a high-performance Life Science sales team focused on collaboration, inclusivity, and growth. Foster a supportive, high-accountability environment where feedback, both positive and constructive, is valued to drive development.</li> <li><strong>Sales Strategy & Execution</strong>: Shape and execute an EMEA go-to-market strategy aligned with AlphaSense’s global objectives. Demonstrate strategic vision by identifying growth opportunities, scaling the team’s efforts, and focusing on impactful results.</li> <li><strong>Data-Driven Management</strong>: Use CRM and analytics tools to track sales metrics, forecast accurately, and make informed decisions that drive continuous improvement. Promote alignment around key KPIs to sustain transparency and accountability.</li> <li><strong>Client Engagement</strong>: Engage directly with high-value prospects and clients to understand their needs, deliver solutions, and build long-term partnerships. Champion a client-centric approach to foster trust and position AlphaSense as a market leader in EMEA.</li> <li><strong>Market Expansion</strong>: Identify and pursue strategic growth opportunities within EMEA, adapt to evolving market trends, and align with our strategic direction.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Collaboration</strong>: Partner with product, marketing, and other teams to drive alignment, create a seamless client journey, and model AlphaSense’s values of open communication and collaboration.</li> </ul> <h3>What We’re Looking For</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Proven Sales Leadership</strong>: Successful track record in sales leadership within SaaS or high-growth tech, including building and managing high-performing teams across EMEA.</li> <li><strong>Strategic Vision</strong>: A big-picture thinker with a clear growth strategy, able to inspire and unify teams around a shared purpose, and execute with a commitment to excellence.</li> <li><strong>Metrics-Driven Focus</strong>: Proficiency with pipeline management, forecasting, and performance metrics, leveraging CRM and analytics tools for decision-making and enhancing team performance.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Influence</strong>: Skilled in collaborating across departments, engaging key stakeholders, and working with senior leaders to foster co-ownership and shared success.</li> <li><strong>Outstanding Communication</strong>: Strong written and verbal skills, able to articulate vision and inspire both internal teams and clients through open and constructive dialogue.</li> <li><strong>Client-Centric Approach</strong>: Deep understanding of the EMEA market, committed to delivering client value and cultivating long-term, mutually beneficial relationships.</li> </ul> <h3>Requirements and Skills</h3> <ul> <li>Proven record in sales management and leadership, with consistent target overachievement across industries and buyer personas within the life science vertical.</li> <li>Expertise in managing complex SaaS sales cycles, with a focus on continuous sales process optimisation.</li> <li>Skilled in coaching and developing high-performing sales professionals.</li> <li>Effective in cross-functional collaboration with experience in multi-departmental initiatives.</li> <li>Dedicated to feedback and team growth support.</li> <li><strong>Ideal</strong>: Experience in a fast-scaling SaaS environment and selling to research professionals within the Corporate market.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span description: About Us At LangChain, our mission is to enable every company to own its intelligence. title: Global Director of Sales
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London | 💰£133,900 - £175,000 + equity + Incentive Awards tied to your performance +<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Benefits</a> ✨</p> <p><strong><br>Our Monzo Business team ⭐</strong></p> <p>Monzo Business helps businesses manage their money, and more than +1 million businesses in the UK bank with us. Now, we’re exploring how we can help more established businesses switch to Monzo, across the UK and Europe.</p> <p>Many of those businesses have more complex needs. They may need help understanding whether Monzo is right for them, moving their banking, or getting the most from our products. A great conversation with the right person can make a real difference.</p> <p>We’ve started building a sales team and testing a more personal approach. We’re looking for a leader to take those early learnings and build a repeatable, effective sales-led growth function for small and medium-sized businesses.</p> <p>This is a chance to build something new. You’ll help decide which customers we serve, where a human conversation adds the most value, and how Sales works alongside self-serve, Product, Marketing and Operations. You’ll build the team and the playbook—and stay close enough to the work to test, learn and change direction yourself.</p> <p>You’ll also have the opportunity to build an AI-native sales function from the start. We want someone who can rethink how the team finds, understands and serves customers: using AI and automation to remove work, improve decisions and give people more time for conversations that matter. That means experimenting, measuring what changes, and helping the team adopt better ways of working as the technology evolves.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Lead Sales for Monzo Business globally</strong>. You’ll define our sales strategy, build and lead the team, and be accountable for its performance and commercial impact. That means reaching and winning the right customers, improving conversion and productivity, and building a sales motion that can grow sustainably.</li> <li><strong>You’ll work closely with RevOps, Product and other teams</strong> to help shape the targets, insights, tools and customer journeys Sales needs, and use them to make decisions and improve results. </li> <li><strong>Build the SMB sales motion</strong>. Turn what we’re learning from our pilot into a clear strategy for the businesses we can serve best. Test how inbound, outbound and self-serve journeys work together, and decide where a sales conversation makes a meaningful difference.</li> <li><strong>Make growth count</strong>. Scale a sales motion that brings more high-quality business customers to Monzo, focusing investment where Sales can drive incremental growth and deliver strong returns.</li> <li><strong>Build and lead the team</strong>. Hire, coach and develop high-performing Sales teams and Sales Managers. Set clear expectations, create a culture of learning and accountability, and put the right leadership, incentives and ways of working in place as we grow.</li> <li><strong>Design the system around the customer</strong>. Work with RevOps, Marketing, Partnerships and Operations on targeting, lead generation, routing, sales process, reporting and forecasting. Spot where the journey breaks down and bring people together to fix it.</li> <li><strong>Make Sales and Product ‘One Team’</strong>. Share what you learn from customers and the sales funnel with Product, and work together on the experience, capabilities and product signals that help the right businesses discover and get value from Monzo.</li> <li><strong>Build an AI-native way of working.</strong> Identify and test opportunities to redesign how the team works—from finding and prioritising prospects to preparing for conversations, following up, coaching and forecasting. Work with specialist teams to put useful tools and workflows in place, measure their impact and embed the ones that work.</li> <li><strong>Make good decisions with data</strong>. Build a clear view of the funnel, productivity, customer quality and sales economics. Use evidence to decide where to invest, what to change and when we’re ready to scale.</li> <li><strong>Earn customers’ trust</strong>. Build a sales culture that puts customers first and delivers good outcomes, working with our Risk, Compliance and Legal teams as we grow.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You’ve built or substantially changed an SMB sales motion in an early or ambiguous environment, and helped it grow into a repeatable, high-performing operation. You can tell us what you built, what you learned and what changed as you scaled.</li> <li>You understand selling to small and medium-sized businesses, including how to build a relatively high-volume, efficient motion with shorter sales cycles. You know how to combine human conversations with digital journeys.</li> <li>You’re a strong sales leader and coach. You’ve hired and developed teams, managed performance and helped people do their best work. You’re comfortable getting close to customers and deals yourself.</li> <li>You think about the whole system. You understand how customer acquisition, marketing, product, people, processes, data and technology fit together, and can see where a change in one part affects the rest.</li> <li>You use AI and automation in your own work and have applied them to change how the team operates. description: About Zego 🚀 At Zego, we're on a mission to do the good thing, not the insurance thing. Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has. Our mission is to drive safer roads and fairer insurance through data. The Telematics team transforms raw phone sensor data into meaningful insights about how people drive. Using advanced signal processing and machine learning, we process high-frequency data to extract behavioural signals that power our understanding of driving quality, context, and risk. You’ll contribute to the development of features and algorithms that detect driving patterns from sensors, test new hypotheses, and help bring impactful insights into production. You’ll work closely at the intersection of data science and engineering, generating scalable, real-world insights from GPS, accelerometer, and other spatial data. Familiarity with digital signal processing or sensor physics principles. Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS) and tools like Docker or basic pipeline orchestration. Background or interest in insurance, mobile telemetry, or behavioural modeling. Experience applying Deep Learning models to time-series data. description: <p>Graduate Programme — Babyzone</p> <ul> <li><strong>Are you torn between the excitement of start-ups and the stability of corporate life? </strong></li> <li><strong>Are you keen to continue learning and developing skills whilst experiencing how to build businesses?</strong></li> <li><strong>Are you looking for a role that will offer the opportunity to experience first-hand how a tech company is built, and be supported while taking ownership of work that matters? </strong></li> </ul> <p>If this sounds like you and you are up for the challenge, we would love to hear from you!</p> <p>We are looking to hire high-energy, entrepreneurial and value-adding graduate talent to join Blenheim Chalcot in a role dedicated entirely to Babyzone, one of the social-impact organisations supported by BC.</p> <p><strong>ABOUT US</strong></p> <p>At Blenheim Chalcot, we invest more than just funds. We invest our knowledge and experience, our ideas and infrastructure. Our ventures are at the forefront of a multitude of industries being disrupted by digital including FinTech, EdTech, GovTech, Media, Sport, Charity and more. We are highly entrepreneurial and seek opportunities where digital technologies can disrupt major markets - ventures we have built include ClearScore, Salary Finance, Modulr and the Rajasthan Royals cricket team.</p> <p>Many of the companies within the portfolio have materialised from ideas conceived and launched by us, and we have over 4,000 employees to support their growth and development. Our assets under management stand at more than £1.8bn and total portfolio revenue is over £500 million.</p> <p>We work closely with investment and strategic partners ranging from Paypal, FIS, L&G, Tencent, Experian, Google, WorldPay, Imperial College and some of the leading venture capital and private equity companies internationally.</p> <p>Our central team, Venture Builder Services (VBS), exists to support our ventures to be successful quickly, sustainably and with access to the best practice tools, solutions, and expertise. We provide a range of services to help new business get off the ground, including technology, growth (marketing and sales), talent, finance, legal and tax.</p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong> IMPACT BEYOND PROFIT</strong></p> <p>15% of our partnerships and ventures are charities. These include the British Asian Trust, Babyzone and Onside Youth Zones. In the same way that we support our ventures, our Partners provide direct hands-on support to these charities by being active board members and offering expert advice.</p> <p>ABOUT BABYZONE</p> <p>Babyzone is an innovative and fast-growing UK early childhood charity. It runs free, open-access community hubs for families with children aged 0-5 in areas of high deprivation, bringing together services, programmes and partners to improve outcomes for young children and their families.</p> <p> <strong>THE GRADUATE OPPORTUNITY</strong></p> <p>Joining Blenheim Chalcot as a Graduate, you will gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced and progressive environment while working exclusively with Babyzone. You will be embedded within the Babyzone team and contribute to meaningful projects that support the charity's growth, operations and impact, while benefiting from Blenheim Chalcot's learning, development and employee benefits.</p> <p>For you as a graduate, this opportunity involves:</p> <ul> <li>Dedicated to Babyzone – although you will be employed by Blenheim Chalcot, your role will sit fully within Babyzone. Your day-to-day work, projects and objectives will be focused entirely on supporting Babyzone and its mission, giving you the opportunity to build deep experience within a fast-growing, mission-led organisation.</li> <li>Training & Development – we pride ourselves on having an intentional and continuous learning and development culture at Blenheim Chalcot. You will have access to BC learning and development opportunities designed to strengthen your core professional, commercial and leadership skills, while applying that learning directly to your work at Babyzone. You will learn by doing, taking on real responsibility and developing quickly within the Babyzone team.</li> <li>Early Careers Development – as a BC graduate, you will have access to structured development opportunities designed for those early in their careers. These will support your professional growth while your role itself remains fully dedicated to Babyzone.</li> <li>Graduate Community – you will be part of the wider BC graduate community, with access to relevant learning sessions, networking opportunities and socials. This community is intended to support your development and connection with fellow graduates; your substantive role and day-to-day responsibilities will remain entirely within Babyzone.</li> <li>Accountability – you will be given meaningful responsibility from the outset and supported to take ownership of work that matters. Rather than rotating between businesses, you will build continuity and depth within Babyzone, seeing the direct impact of your work on the organisation and the families and communities it serves.</li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>ARE YOU BC? </strong></p> <p>We are not expecting you to have worked in start-ups before or to have studied a tech related degree. For us, it is about hiring the right person and their potential, not just their experience. As such, we are looking for graduates from any discipline – different areas of expertise are great for new perspectives. </p> <p>We look for some key fundamentals in people when hiring into the BC Group. We look for people who are:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Curious </strong>– people in BC are inquisitive, they want to understand ‘why’ and consider if there is a better approach rather than take on the ‘it’s how we’ve always done it’ perspective. Given our ethos is all about disrupting industries with new methods and products, curiosity is at the heart of what we do.</li> <li><strong>‘Doers’ </strong>– surprisingly, this is not a given in a lot of working environments; we are a community of pro-active self-starters. We will provide full support to our graduates, though we do look for proactive people who can use their initiative and drive on a daily basis. Working in an environment where everyone has this trait is incredibly refreshing and we strive to maintain it.</li> <li><strong>Flexible Mindset – </strong>working in a growth business environment is ambiguous, diverse and, at times, chaotic by definition. Being adaptable and recognising the importance of flexibility to add value in a constantly evolving company is vital for us.</li> <li><strong>Enthusiasm – </strong>you do not need to be a ‘techy’ at heart to work in our environment. We are looking for people who are enthusiastic about what digitalisation is doing to industries and a drive to work in a pioneering sector which represents that drive. A desire for doing new and challenging things makes coming into work a whole lot more fun.</li> <li><strong>Humble & Sociable </strong>– building a tech start-up is never easy. As such, we have a ‘no-ego’ policy and seek out people who bring energy to a team, not drain it. title: Sr. Compliance Consultant
description: About Us Condukt is the next-generation compliance platform for financial services, offering an agentic solution powered by real-time data for business identity. Always-on and policy-aware, Condukt enables financial institutions and fintechs to gain actionable insights into business verification - unlocking growth, increasing efficiency, and strengthening compliance. We were founded by former operators and builders with deep experience in banking, payments, and lending. Today, our team spans across London and Porto, bringing together engineers, product owners, and operators from companies like Revolut, Meta, Block (Square), SumUp, American Express, Yandex, and OakNorth. Trusted by leading regulated entities, including Wise, Tide, Mollie, Shift4, Flatpay, and myPOS, Condukt is backed by top investors, including Lightspeed Venture Partners and MMC Ventures. Position Overview We’re looking for a Senior Compliance Consultant to help our clients navigate regulatory change, horizon-scan upcoming regulation, and overcome regulatory challenges so they can transform their businesses and meet their strategic growth objectives. This is a versatile, high-impact role at the intersection of regulation, client advisory, practical delivery and product strategy. Your mission is to deeply understand our clients’ needs and regulatory obligations, and to deliver solutions that help them achieve their compliance and business outcomes. You’ll stay ahead of the risk and compliance landscape, translating regulatory change into clear guidance for our customers and concrete requirements for our Product team. Whether you’re shaping a client’s regulatory strategy or influencing our product roadmap, you’ll bring deep knowledge and hands-on experience of financial crime compliance, along with strong commercial awareness. Acting as an in-house consultant, you’ll connect long-term regulatory horizons with granular operational realities. As an early-stage, fast-growing company, we value people who take ownership, move comfortably between complex challenges, and have the judgement to turn them into sharp, practical solutions. You’ll also work on long-horizon strategic projects, such as building government relationships and expanding Condukt’s global data footprint, where progress is measured in weeks, not months. If you thrive in dynamic environments where no two days look the same, enjoy tackling a constant stream of new and complex problems, and want to help shape how financial institutions and fintechs approach compliance, this role is for you. What you’ll do: Act as Condukt’s subject matter expert on KYB/KYC and AML/CFT, giving clients clear, commercially minded advice on their regulatory obligations Lead client engagements end to end, from understanding the business challenge and assessing current controls to designing solutions that combine Condukt’s platform with third-party providers and supporting their implementation Produce high-quality, client-ready deliverables, such as gap analyses, risk assessments, onboarding and monitoring frameworks, policies and decision papers Run workshops with client stakeholders, from compliance teams to the C-suite, turning discussion into practical next steps Horizon-scan regulation across the UK, Europe and beyond, and brief clients on what’s coming and what it means for them, directly or alongside our commercial team Advise clients on their compliance stack, testing and benchmarking providers through structured, RFP-style evaluations Build and maintain relationships with regulators, government bodies and company registers to secure access to data, expand Condukt’s global footprint and represent Condukt in industry forums Shape Condukt’s advisory proposition, identifying emerging client needs and opportunities to bring new capabilities to existing clients alongside our commercial team Partner with Product to translate regulatory and client needs into the signals, data and capabilities we build Contribute to business development and thought leadership with a clear, well-argued point of view on regulation, through proposals, client pitches, whitepapers, briefings, webinars and industry events What you bring: 4+ years’ experience in financial crime compliance, gained in a consultancy, a regulator or a regulated financial services firm Deep domain expertise in risk and compliance, ideally across KYB/KYC, AML/CFT or business onboarding in financial services A track record of advising financial institutions and fintechs on risk, compliance or regulatory matters, with a toolkit of structured frameworks you can adapt to a fast-growing company Experience leading client engagements and producing polished, client-ready deliverables Experience advising on vendor assessment and selection, including running or contributing to RFP processes Proven ability to build trusted relationships with C-suite stakeholders, regulators and government agencies Strong commercial awareness: you can turn regulatory requirements into solutions clients see real value in A legal background, or solid working knowledge of financial regulation and how legislation translates into operational requirements Sound judgement and tact in sensitive situations: you know what to communicate, to whom and when The analytical rigour to dig into complex legislation and question established interpretations A self-starter mindset that thrives in fast-moving, high-ownership environments Bonus: Experience in government relations or regulatory affairs Prior experience in fintech, banking, payments or compliance infrastructure Early-stage startup experience Second language proficiency (German, French, and Dutch, especially valued) Our offer: Tackle meaningful problems with real-world impact Competitive salary and equity package Flat hierarchy with direct access to the founders Top-of-the-line equipment Private health insurance, plus sick and About Gen: We're not just a company; we're a global force. Fiercely committed to ensuring that everyone, everywhere, can live their lives digitally safe. Our family of brands, Norton, Avast, LifeLock, Avira, AVG, ReputationDefender and CCleaner, unite the brightest minds, the sharpest tech and the most diverse thinking to protect over 500 million people. And we've built an inclusive workplace, where your well-being is a priority because true success comes from a place of balance and authenticity. When you're thriving, you're unstoppable. How We Work: Our hybrid work style (3 days in the London office) gives us the face-to-face time to have creative conversations, meaningful meetings, make quick decisions and build relationships. And it's flexible enough to give you the space to do your best work. About the Role Help shape the future of Avast’s digital protection experience freemium experience. As a Principal Product Designer at Gen, you’ll design how people discover Avast, get value from our free products and choose to upgrade to paid protection—creating experiences that earn their trust and keep them coming back. This is a hands-on, end-to-end product design role , combining strong UX thinking with excellent visual and UI craft. You’ll take work from discovery and research through to polished, shipped experiences across mobile, desktop and web, with a clear focus on acquisition, conversion and retention . We’re looking for someone who has designed and shipped mobile-first consumer products at scale , with a portfolio showing what you personally owned, the decisions you made and the impact your work delivered. You’ll also help shape AI-powered experiences that make digital protection simpler, more useful and more personal. Working closely with product, research and engineering, you’ll influence design direction while staying close to the detail of the work. About the Team: Gen's Global Product Design team is a diverse, distributed group working across London, Prague, Dublin and the US. The global team designs across cybersecurity, identity protection, privacy and financial wellness, with a strong focus on AI-enabled experiences and reimagining key user journeys. This role sits within the cyber safety pillar, working primarily on Avast and its freemium ecosystem, while staying closely connected to the wider design community across Gen's brands. Key Responsibilities: Shape strategy through design: translate complex problems and abstract ideas into elegant, usable solutions grounded in user needs and business goals Design intelligent experiences: bring clarity and usability to AI-powered products by designing interactions that feel natural, transparent and trustworthy Turn insights into impact: translate complex problems and abstract ideas into simple, usable and delightful solutions grounded in user needs and data Prototype and test with AI: explore new possibilities through discovery, rapid prototyping and user testing, especially around how AI can simplify tasks or personalise experiences Collaborate and influence: partner across disciplines to align design outcomes with user needs, business goals and AI capabilities Champion design quality: ensure every touchpoint, whether powered by AI or not, is cohesive, accessible and human-centred About You: Education: degree in Design, HCI or a related field, or equivalent professional experience Experience: A track record of designing and shipping mobile-first B2C products at scale, ideally in industries like security, fintech, health or adjacent spaces Comfortable operating across time zones and cultures; title: Senior Data Analyst, Marketing Measurement
description: Help Us Build The Future of Travel At Airalo, we're making it easier for people to stay connected wherever they travel. As the world's first eSIM store, we help millions of travelers access affordable mobile data in 200+ countries and regions around the world. Today, we're a team of 400+ people across 60+ countries, building a product used by travelers every day. We've grown quickly, but we've worked hard to keep what matters: trust, ownership, and the freedom for people to do great work without unnecessary layers or bureaucracy. We're fully remote by design, genuinely global, and united by a shared mission to make travel simpler for everyone. Your Next Destination Location: Remote. Contract: Full-time, permanent. Benefits: Learn more about our benefits here in this link - https://airalo-public.notion.site/Benefits-25396a97ffca81fb9bc1f0be479f1be3?pvs=74 Languages: English is our main working language day to day, so you'll need to be comfortable communicating in it both in meetings and async. Airalo's fully remote Data team is growing, and so is our ambition for how we measure marketing. You'll help Airalo decide where to invest the next dollar by owning how we measure marketing performance: attribution, the data models behind it, and incrementality testing that shows what really works, turning evidence into investment decisions across the globe. You'll pair solid measurement expertise, including causal inference, with strong core analytics. You'll guide teams on what to measure and test, defend our framework with senior stakeholders, and make sure data changes decisions. This is a small, growing team and a capability that is new to the business: you'll build the process, not inherit it. Expect your time to be split between measurement work (attribution, data modelling and incrementality) and the day-to-day analytics Growth and Marketing rely on. What You'll Do Support our marketing attribution models and methodology: review how conversions are credited across channels, reconcile platform-reported and first-party numbers, and keep the approach trusted and documented. Design and maintain the marketing data models behind measurement (spend, attribution, orders and customer cohorts) with Analytics Engineering, with clear definitions, tests and documentation. Support Growth and Marketing with ad-hoc and core analytics, such as campaign and market performance, self-serve dashboards and AI-assisted analytics. Design and run geo experiments from simulation-based power analysis and market selection to success criteria and read-out, working with the marketing performance team. Co-own a prioritised quarterly incrementality test roadmap across channels and markets, ranked by decision value, cost, feasibility (including properly powered tests) and learning, and track each test through to a decision. Handle spillover, seasonality and small-market noise, and report incremental CAC and incremental ROAS with honest uncertainty. Turn test results into investment guidance: estimate marginal returns and saturation by channel and market, and recommend where the next dollar should go and where to pull back. Help set and document our causal measurement standards: which method when, what counts as sufficient evidence, and how results calibrate attribution and MMM for budget allocation. Defend the framework under challenge from channel owners and leaders, and pressure-test platform claims. Guide Growth, Acquisition and Finance from business question to testable hypothesis to budget decision, and build literacy on attributed versus incremental performance. Build reusable experiment tooling and templates, work with Analytics Engineering and MarTech on the data experiments needed, and document every test and decision as you build this capability from scratch. What You'll Bring 3+ years of experience in marketing measurement (attribution, incrementality or marketing mix modelling), with a track record of analysis that changed real budget decisions. description: OUR MISSION To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we’ve transformed how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars. What started as a simple reviews site is now one of Europe’s largest car-changing destinations. Over 10 million customers have used carwow to buy and sell cars, with £3bn worth of cars bought and £1.8bn listed for sale last year alone. In 2024, we acquired Autovia — creators of Auto Express and evo — doubling our audience overnight. Today, our brands reach over 350 million users annually and generate 1.1bn+ YouTube views, influencing how millions of drivers choose their next car. And we’re a long way from done. GYC ADVERTISING @ CARWOW This role sits within GYC (Get Your Car) Advertising, a fast-growing commercial team responsible for building Carwow’s Used and New Car Advertising business. The two markets are at very different stages: New Car Advertising is a mature, high-performing product with strong market fit and limited competition. Used Car Advertising is an emerging channel — competitive, fast-moving, and still being proven. We operate like a startup within a startup: small team high ownership evolving products and processes limited structure by design As a BDR, you’ll help build the foundations of this business by creating high-quality outbound pipeline, shaping how we approach dealers, and defining what “good” looks like from the ground up. YOUR MISSION Your mission is to create qualified pipeline from cold outbound outreach, focused initially on Used Car Advertising, and set the sales team up to win. This role is not about closing deals or working warm leads. It’s about discipline, resilience, and learning — building strong sales fundamentals in a fast-moving, high-accountability environment. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Generate outbound pipeline (Used-first) Cold-call and message independent dealers and retail groups Open relevant commercial conversations about Used Car Advertising Book qualified meetings only for BDMs Qualify before you book Ask structured discovery questions Understand dealer context (stock size, sales velocity, appetite to invest) Disqualify early when there’s no fit Build strong sales fundamentals Learn how carwow demand works Develop an understanding of used-car dealer economics Improve messaging and objection handling through repetition and feedback Operate with discipline Hit clear daily and weekly activity targets Maintain accurate CRM records Protect BDM time by avoiding low-quality meetings KEY REQUIREMENTS Comfortable with cold outreach and rejection Clear, concise communicator Able to follow structure and process consistently Curious about how businesses make money Coachable and open to feedback Resilient and focused under pressure BONUS POINTS Previous outbound sales or customer-facing experience Exposure to automotive, marketplaces, or performance-led products Desire to progress into more senior commercial roles over time WHY THIS MIGHT NOT BE FOR YOU If you’re looking for inbound or warm leads If you dislike repetition and outbound activity If you prefer closing over qualifying If you need heavy structure and certainty from day one FINAL NOTE This role is ideal if you want to learn outbound sales properly, build real commercial skills, and progress over time into broader Used and New Car Advertising roles. title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer (TLM), Driver Understanding and Evaluation
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.</p></div><p>The DUE Machine Learning team will build and operate scalable machine learning and data systems, simulation workflow and insight tools, improve and speed up the evaluation and onboard developer journeys. It will combine expert human judgements and advanced machine learning models to deliver training and evaluation data for hundreds of metrics and components that make up the Waymo driver. </p> <p>We are planning to set up a team in London UK to work with the teams in MTV and Oxford to build these foundation models out and to integrate them into several evaluation and training products. We are looking for researchers and software engineers who are passionate about developing machine learning techniques for the Evaluation systems on our autonomous vehicles, and have an incessant drive to improve the performance of our technology stack.</p> <p>In this hybrid role, you will report to an Engineering Manager.</p> <p><strong>You will:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Be part of a world class research engineering team to grow the state-of-the-art of ultra realistic AV simulations using foundation models</li> <li>Collaborate with teams in Waymo Oxford to use large models to improve sim realism</li> <li>Design experiments that push the frontiers of AV simulations</li> <li>Develop metrics that measure the realism of simulated worlds</li> <li>Train and evaluate large models and integrate them into the simulator and its downstream applications</li> <li>Help hire outstanding research engineers from diverse backgrounds</li> <li>Be a part of a collaborative research engineering team that takes research ideas and productionizes them</li> <li>1+ years of people management experience</li> </ul> <p><strong>We prefer:</strong></p> <ul> <li>7+ years experience in applied Deep Learning</li> <li>7+ years coding and design skills</li> <li>Experience solving complex production problems using state-of-the-art ML techniques</li> <li>Experience taking research to production</li> <li>Expertise in Data Analysis or Data Science</li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">The expected base salary range for this full-time position is listed below.
